# Agent rules

Read [OWNER-DIRECTIVES.md](OWNER-DIRECTIVES.md) first. It overrides conflicting
roadmap and tooling text. Follow the active `work/WO-*.md`; inspect its allowed
and protected paths before editing. Keep each work order buildable, tested,
verified, and recorded in `STATE.md` and the ledgers.

## Platform and product locks

- Initial support is Apple Silicon macOS 13+. Do not add Linux/Windows code,
  shims, CI jobs, runners, packaging, or portability work.
- Keep platform implementations behind `platform/` interfaces; do not add
  stubs for unsupported operating systems.
- Rust for all first-party code is the active owner-approved migration target.
  MPL-2.0, minimal pinned dependencies, custom-drawn UI, and an owned SVG
  parser/rasterizer remain locked. Legacy C17 code is preserved as migration
  reference; do not resume old C implementation orders. See ADR-0022.
- Never read, fetch, or copy GPL SVG-editor source. Do not fetch external SVG
  resources from the application. Record provenance for external algorithms.

## Repository map

- `app/`: executable composition.
- `src/`: base, platform, XML/SVG, scene, raster, document, UI modules as added.
- `docs/research-r4/`: authoritative operating model and roadmap.
- `docs/research-r3/plan/`: architecture and coding guidance where r4 is silent.
- `docs/adr/`: accepted decisions; `work/`: immutable ready work orders.
- `tests/`: unit, property, fuzz, UI, and oracle tests as introduced.
- `bench/`: corpus metadata, generators, runners, and results.
- `artifacts/`: work-order evidence; `build/` and `.cache/` are generated.

## Commands

The commands below are the preserved legacy C workflow. Rust workspace/build
commands become authoritative only through their implementation orders.

- `./dev build`: configure and build Debug.
- `./dev test-fast`: run local Python tests and validate the ledger.
- `./dev verify`: run the Debug build and fast tests.
- `cmake --preset mac-release && cmake --build --preset mac-release`: Release.
- `python3 scripts/ledger.py validate ledger.jsonl`: validate work history.
- `python3 -m unittest`: run Python harness tests when present.
- `bench`, `fmt`, `lint`, `asan`, and `fuzz` become authoritative only when
  their work orders implement them; do not claim missing commands run.

## Engineering and safety

Use the contracts in `docs/CODING_STANDARD.md`: explicit ownership, pointer+length
slices, checked size arithmetic, bounded user input, no VLAs, and no unsafe
string functions. Preserve unknown SVG/XML source. Keep generated files in
ignored repo-local directories. Do not install system packages or touch sibling
directories. Add dependencies only through an ADR and pinned provenance record.

Never weaken frozen acceptance tests or oracles. Run commands named by the
active work order, then report exact evidence. Do not invent test or performance
results. Keep source files focused and under 800 lines; split cohesive modules
before they grow further.

## Rust migration execution

Follow `docs/product/rust-port-goal-and-plan.md` and ready Rust work orders.
Multiple Luna codex exec processes are authorized, with isolated current-source
worktrees and disjoint modules; coordinator alone changes shared manifests,
locks, interfaces and ledgers. Use Low for inventory/docs, Medium for routine
ports, High for parser/renderer/concurrency/unsafe FFI. Escalate only on a named
problem; use the existing subscription allowance and no purchased credits.
Preserve strict validation, original fixtures/assertions and byte-preserving
round trips. Rust ownership replaces manual C ownership conventions; bounded
inputs, checked arithmetic, safe cleanup and source limits still apply. Keep
unsafe operations behind documented platform/FFI boundaries.

impl DocumentIdAllocator {

static NEXT_DOCUMENT_ID: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(1);

pub(crate) fn allocate_document_id() -> Option<u64> {
    NEXT_DOCUMENT_ID.try_update(Ordering::Relaxed, Ordering::Relaxed, next_document_id).ok()
}

fn next_document_id(current: u64) -> Option<u64> {
    if current == 0 || current == u64::MAX { None } else { Some(current + 1) }

/// An immutable-source document with safely owned indexes and mutable live
/// state. The source borrow must outlive this model.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct DocumentModel<'source> {
    pub(crate) source: &'source [u8],
    pub(crate) id: u64,
    pub(crate) nodes: Vec<Node>,
    pub(crate) attributes: Vec<Attribute>,
    pub(crate) live_node_count: usize,
    pub(crate) root: Option<u32>,
}

impl<'source> DocumentModel<'source> {
    pub(crate) fn from_parts(
        source: &'source [u8],
        id: u64,
        nodes: Vec<Node>,
        attributes: Vec<Attribute>,
        root: Option<u32>,
    ) -> Self {
        let live_node_count = nodes.len();
        Self { source, id, nodes, attributes, live_node_count, root }
    }

    pub fn document_id(&self) -> u64 { self.id }
    pub fn source(&self) -> &'source [u8] { self.source }
    pub fn node_count(&self) -> usize { self.nodes.len() }
    pub fn live_node_count(&self) -> usize { self.live_node_count }

    pub fn root(&self) -> Option<DocumentHandle> {
        let slot = self.root?;
        self.nodes.get(slot as usize).filter(|node| node.live)?;
        Some(self.handle(slot))
    }

    pub fn first_child(&self, parent: DocumentHandle) -> Option<DocumentHandle> {
        let node = self.resolve(parent)?;
        let mut child = node.first_child;
        while child != NO_SLOT {
            let current = self.nodes.get(child as usize)?;
            if current.live { return Some(self.handle(child)); }
            child = current.next_sibling;
        }
        None
    }

    pub fn next_sibling(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<DocumentHandle> {
        let node = self.resolve(handle)?;
        let mut sibling = node.next_sibling;
        while sibling != NO_SLOT {
            let current = self.nodes.get(sibling as usize)?;
            if current.live { return Some(self.handle(sibling)); }
            sibling = current.next_sibling;
        }
        None
    }

    pub fn parent(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<DocumentHandle> {
        let node = self.resolve(handle)?;
        if node.parent == NO_SLOT { return None; }
        self.nodes.get(node.parent as usize).filter(|parent| parent.live)?;
        Some(self.handle(node.parent))
    }

    pub fn tag_name(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<&'source [u8]> {
        self.resolve(handle)?.name.slice(self.source)
    }

    pub fn attribute_count(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> usize {
        self.resolve(handle).map_or(0, |node| node.attribute_count)
    }

    pub fn attribute_at(&self, handle: DocumentHandle, index: usize) -> Option<(&'source [u8], &'source [u8])> {
        let node = self.resolve(handle)?;
        if index >= node.attribute_count { return None; }
        let attribute = self.attributes.get(node.first_attribute.checked_add(index)?)?;
        Some((attribute.name.slice(self.source)?, attribute.value.slice(self.source)?))
    }

    pub fn depth(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<usize> {
        Some(self.resolve(handle)?.depth)
    }

    pub fn node_at(&self, slot: usize) -> Option<DocumentHandle> {
        let index = u32::try_from(slot).ok()?;
        self.nodes.get(slot).filter(|node| node.live)?;
        Some(self.handle(index))
    }

    pub fn source_span(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<DocumentSourceSpan> {
        Some(self.resolve(handle)?.source)
    }

    /// Removes a node and all descendants. Slots remain stable; each live
    /// generation advances so previously issued handles cannot resolve.
    pub fn remove_subtree(&mut self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> bool {
        if self.resolve(handle).is_none() { return false; }
        for index in 0..self.nodes.len() {
            if !self.is_descendant_or_self(index, handle.slot as usize) { continue; }
            let node = &mut self.nodes[index];
            if node.live {
                node.live = false;
                self.live_node_count -= 1;
                if node.generation != u32::MAX { node.generation += 1; }
            }
        }
        if self.root == Some(handle.slot) { self.root = None; }
        true
    }

    fn is_descendant_or_self(&self, index: usize, ancestor: usize) -> bool {
        let mut current = index;
        loop {
            if current == ancestor { return true; }
            let Some(node) = self.nodes.get(current) else { return false; };
            if node.parent == NO_SLOT { return false; }
            current = node.parent as usize;
        }
    }

    fn resolve(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<&Node> {
        if handle.document_id != self.id { return None; }
        let node = self.nodes.get(handle.slot as usize)?;
        (node.live && node.generation == handle.generation).then_some(node)
    }

    fn handle(&self, slot: u32) -> DocumentHandle {
        DocumentHandle { document_id: self.id, slot, generation: self.nodes[slot as usize].generation }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn checked_table_bytes<T>(count: usize) -> Option<usize> {
    count.checked_mul(size_of::<T>())
}

pub(crate) const fn no_slot() -> u32 { NO_SLOT }

const TOKEN_STORAGE_LIMIT: usize = 64 * 1024 * 1024;
const MAX_DEPTH: usize = 256;
const MAX_OPEN_NAME_BYTES: usize = MAX_DEPTH * size_of::<XmlSpan>();
const STEP_BYTES: usize = 64 * 1024;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum DocumentError {
    InvalidArgument,
    Parse,

    ResourceExhausted,

}

impl DocumentError {

            Self::Parse => "parse",

            Self::OutOfMemory => "out_of_memory",

        }
    }
}

pub struct DocumentParseError {
    pub error: DocumentError,
    pub diagnostic: XmlDiagnostic,
}

pub fn parse_document(source: &[u8]) -> Result<DocumentModel<'_>, DocumentParseError> {
    parse_document_with_storage(source, TOKEN_STORAGE_LIMIT)
}

pub(crate) fn parse_document_with_storage(source: &[u8], storage_limit: usize) -> Result<DocumentModel<'_>, DocumentParseError> {
    if storage_limit < size_of::<XmlToken>() {
        return Err(DocumentParseError { error: DocumentError::ResourceExhausted, diagnostic: XmlDiagnostic::default() });
    }
    if source.len() > vexel_xml::MAX_INPUT_BYTES {
        return Err(DocumentParseError {
            error: DocumentError::Limit,
            diagnostic: XmlDiagnostic { category: XmlError::InputLimit, offset: 0 },
        });
    }

    let mut stream = XmlTokenStream::new(source, storage_limit).map_err(|_| DocumentParseError {
        error: DocumentError::OutOfMemory,
        diagnostic: XmlDiagnostic::default(),
    })?;
    if stream.token_storage_bytes() > storage_limit
        || stream.open_name_storage_bytes() > MAX_OPEN_NAME_BYTES
    {
        return Err(DocumentParseError { error: DocumentError::OutOfMemory, diagnostic: XmlDiagnostic::default() });
    }
    let status = loop {
        let status = stream.step(STEP_BYTES, false);
        if stream.token_storage_bytes() > storage_limit
            || stream.open_name_storage_bytes() > MAX_OPEN_NAME_BYTES
        {
            return Err(DocumentParseError { error: DocumentError::OutOfMemory, diagnostic: stream.result().diagnostic });
        }
        if status != StreamStatus::Ok { break status; }
    };
    let result = stream.result();
    if status != StreamStatus::Complete || result.diagnostic.category != XmlError::None {
        let error = match result.diagnostic.category {
            XmlError::InputLimit | XmlError::NodeLimit | XmlError::DepthLimit | XmlError::AttributeLimit
            | XmlError::TextLimit => DocumentError::Limit,
            XmlError::OutputExhausted => DocumentError::ResourceExhausted,
            XmlError::None => DocumentError::OutOfMemory,
            _ => DocumentError::Parse,
        };
        return Err(DocumentParseError { error, diagnostic: result.diagnostic });
    }

    if result.element_count == 0 || result.element_count > MAX_NODES || result.element_count > u32::MAX as usize
        || result.attribute_count > vexel_xml::MAX_TOTAL_ATTRIBUTES
        || checked_table_bytes::<Node>(result.element_count).is_none()
        || checked_table_bytes::<Attribute>(result.attribute_count).is_none()
    {
        return Err(DocumentParseError { error: DocumentError::Limit, diagnostic: result.diagnostic });
    }
    let tokens = stream.take().ok_or(DocumentParseError {
        error: DocumentError::Parse,
        diagnostic: result.diagnostic,
    })?;
    if stream.token_storage_bytes() != 0 {
        return Err(DocumentParseError { error: DocumentError::Parse, diagnostic: result.diagnostic });
    }

    let id = allocate_document_id().ok_or(DocumentParseError {
        error: DocumentError::IdExhausted,
        diagnostic: result.diagnostic,
    })?;
    let (nodes, attributes, root) = build_tables(source, &tokens, result.element_count, result.attribute_count)
        .map_err(|error| DocumentParseError { error, diagnostic: result.diagnostic })?;
    Ok(DocumentModel::from_parts(source, id, nodes, attributes, Some(root)))
}

fn build_tables(
    source: &[u8],
    tokens: &[XmlToken],
    node_count: usize,
    attribute_count: usize,
) -> Result<(Vec<Node>, Vec<Attribute>, u32), DocumentError> {
    let mut nodes: Vec<Node> = Vec::new();
    nodes.try_reserve_exact(node_count).map_err(|_| DocumentError::OutOfMemory)?;
    if nodes.capacity() > MAX_NODES { return Err(DocumentError::OutOfMemory); }
    let mut attributes: Vec<Attribute> = Vec::new();
    attributes.try_reserve_exact(attribute_count).map_err(|_| DocumentError::OutOfMemory)?;
    if attributes.capacity() > vexel_xml::MAX_TOTAL_ATTRIBUTES { return Err(DocumentError::OutOfMemory); }
    let mut stack: Vec<u32> = Vec::new();
    stack.try_reserve_exact(MAX_DEPTH).map_err(|_| DocumentError::OutOfMemory)?;
    if stack.capacity() > MAX_DEPTH { return Err(DocumentError::OutOfMemory); }

    let mut root = None;
    let mut index = 0usize;
    while index < tokens.len() {
        let token = tokens[index];
        match token.kind {
            TokenKind::StartElement | TokenKind::EmptyElement => {
                if nodes.len() >= node_count || nodes.len() >= MAX_NODES || nodes.len() >= u32::MAX as usize
                    || token.name.slice(source).is_none() || checked_span(token.source, source).is_none()
                {
                    return Err(DocumentError::Parse);
                }
                let slot = u32::try_from(nodes.len()).map_err(|_| DocumentError::Limit)?;
                let parent = stack.last().copied().unwrap_or(no_slot());
                let depth = stack.len();
                let mut node = Node {
                    name: token.name,
                    source: DocumentSourceSpan { offset: token.source.offset, length: token.source.length },
                    first_attribute: attributes.len(),
                    depth,
                    parent,
                    ..Node::default()
                };
                if parent != no_slot() {
                    let parent_index = parent as usize;
                    let parent_node = nodes.get(parent_index).ok_or(DocumentError::Parse)?;
                    let previous_last = parent_node.last_child;
                    if parent_node.first_child == no_slot() { nodes[parent_index].first_child = slot; }
                    else {
                        let previous = nodes.get_mut(previous_last as usize).ok_or(DocumentError::Parse)?;
                        previous.next_sibling = slot;
                    }
                    nodes[parent_index].last_child = slot;
                } else if parent == no_slot() {
                    if root.replace(slot).is_some() { return Err(DocumentError::Parse); }
                } else {
                    return Err(DocumentError::Parse);
                }

                index += 1;
                while let Some(attribute) = tokens.get(index).filter(|next| next.kind == TokenKind::Attribute) {
                    if attributes.len() >= attribute_count || attribute.name.slice(source).is_none()
                        || attribute.value.slice(source).is_none() || checked_span(attribute.source, source).is_none()
                    {
                        return Err(DocumentError::Parse);
                    }
                    attributes.push(Attribute { name: attribute.name, value: attribute.value });
                    node.attribute_count += 1;
                    index += 1;
                }
                nodes.push(node);
                if token.kind == TokenKind::StartElement {
                    if stack.len() >= MAX_DEPTH { return Err(DocumentError::Limit); }
                    stack.push(slot);
                }
            }
            TokenKind::EndElement => {
                let Some(slot) = stack.pop() else { return Err(DocumentError::Parse); };
                let node = nodes.get_mut(slot as usize).ok_or(DocumentError::Parse)?;
                let end = token.source.offset.checked_add(token.source.length).ok_or(DocumentError::Parse)?;
                let node_end = node.source.offset.checked_add(node.source.length).ok_or(DocumentError::Parse)?;
                if node.source.offset > token.source.offset || end < node_end || end > source.len()
                    || token.name.slice(source).is_none()
                {
                    return Err(DocumentError::Parse);
                }
                node.source.length = end.checked_sub(node.source.offset).ok_or(DocumentError::Parse)?;
                index += 1;
            }
            _ => index += 1,
        }
    }
    if !stack.is_empty() || nodes.len() != node_count || attributes.len() != attribute_count {
        return Err(DocumentError::Parse);
    }
    Ok((nodes, attributes, root.ok_or(DocumentError::Parse)?))
}

fn checked_span<'a>(span: XmlSpan, source: &'a [u8]) -> Option<&'a [u8]> {
    let end = span.offset.checked_add(span.length)?;
    source.get(span.offset..end)
}

use crate::parse::parse_document_with_storage;
use crate::types::DocumentIdAllocator;

const SOURCE: &[u8] = b"<?xml version='1.0'?>\r\n<svg xmlns='urn:svg' xmlns:i='urn:inkscape'><g i:label='keep'><rect id='one'/><i:unknown><path d='M0 0'/></i:unknown></g><circle/></svg>\n";

fn name_is(model: &crate::DocumentModel<'_>, handle: crate::DocumentHandle, expected: &[u8]) -> bool {
    model.tag_name(handle) == Some(expected)
}

#[test]
fn original_fixture_preserves_source_spans_attributes_and_tree_queries() {
    let original = SOURCE.to_vec();
    let first = parse_document(SOURCE).expect("valid source");
    let second = parse_document(SOURCE).expect("same source can open twice");
    assert_eq!(first.node_count(), 6);
    assert_eq!(first.live_node_count(), 6);
    assert_ne!(first.document_id(), second.document_id());
    assert_eq!(first.source(), SOURCE);

    let root = first.root().expect("root");
    assert!(name_is(&first, root, b"svg"));
    let group = first.first_child(root).expect("group");
    assert_eq!(first.first_child(root), Some(group));
    assert!(name_is(&first, group, b"g"));
    assert_eq!(first.parent(group), Some(root));
    assert_eq!(first.depth(root), Some(0));
    assert_eq!(first.depth(group), Some(1));
    assert_eq!(first.node_at(0), Some(root));
    assert_eq!(first.node_at(first.node_count()), None);

    let rectangle = first.first_child(group).expect("rect");
    assert!(name_is(&first, rectangle, b"rect"));
    let unknown = first.next_sibling(rectangle).expect("unknown editor node");
    assert!(name_is(&first, unknown, b"i:unknown"));
    let path = first.first_child(unknown).expect("path");
    assert!(name_is(&first, path, b"path"));
    assert_eq!(first.depth(path), Some(3));
    let circle = first.next_sibling(group).expect("circle");
    assert!(name_is(&first, circle, b"circle"));
    assert_eq!(first.next_sibling(circle), None);
    assert_eq!(first.next_sibling(root), None);

    assert_eq!(first.attribute_count(group), 1);
    assert_eq!(first.attribute_count(root), 2);
    assert_eq!(first.attribute_at(group, 0), Some((&b"i:label"[..], &b"keep"[..])));
    assert_eq!(first.attribute_at(group, 1), None);
    assert_eq!(first.attribute_at(root, 0), Some((&b"xmlns"[..], &b"urn:svg"[..])));
    let group_span = first.source_span(group).expect("group span");
    let expected_group = b"<g i:label='keep'><rect id='one'/><i:unknown><path d='M0 0'/></i:unknown></g>";
    assert_eq!(&SOURCE[group_span.offset..group_span.offset + group_span.length], expected_group);
    let circle_span = first.source_span(circle).expect("empty element span");
    assert_eq!(&SOURCE[circle_span.offset..circle_span.offset + circle_span.length], b"<circle/>");
    assert_eq!(SOURCE, original.as_slice());
}

#[test]
fn foreign_wrong_generation_and_deleted_handles_are_rejected() {
    let mut first = parse_document(SOURCE).unwrap();
    let second = parse_document(SOURCE).unwrap();
    let root = first.root().unwrap();
    let group = first.first_child(root).unwrap();
    let rectangle = first.first_child(group).unwrap();
    let unknown = first.next_sibling(rectangle).unwrap();
    let path = first.first_child(unknown).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(second.tag_name(root), None);
    assert_eq!(first.tag_name(crate::DocumentHandle { slot: u32::MAX, ..root }), None);
    assert_eq!(first.tag_name(crate::DocumentHandle { generation: 0, ..root }), None);
    assert_eq!(first.tag_name(crate::DocumentHandle { generation: root.generation + 1, ..root }), None);
    assert!(first.remove_subtree(group));
    assert_eq!(first.live_node_count(), 2);
    for stale in [group, rectangle, unknown, path] {
        assert_eq!(first.tag_name(stale), None);
        assert_eq!(first.source_span(stale), None);
        assert_eq!(first.parent(stale), None);
    }
    assert_eq!(first.first_child(root).map(|handle| first.tag_name(handle)), Some(Some(&b"circle"[..])));
    assert!(!first.remove_subtree(group));
    assert!(first.remove_subtree(root));
    assert_eq!(first.live_node_count(), 0);
    assert_eq!(first.root(), None);
    assert_eq!(first.node_at(0), None);
    assert_eq!(first.source(), SOURCE);
}

#[test]
fn comments_doctypes_unicode_and_unknown_raw_metadata_remain_in_source() {
    let source = b"<?xml version='1.0'?><!-- note --><!DOCTYPE svg [<!ENTITY local 'raw'>]><svg x:unknown='v&' title='\xc3\xa9'><x:thing/></svg>";
    let model = parse_document(source).expect("supported document constructs");
    assert_eq!(model.node_count(), 2);
    let root = model.root().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(model.attribute_at(root, 0), Some((&b"x:unknown"[..], &b"v&"[..])));
    assert_eq!(model.attribute_at(root, 1), Some((&b"title"[..], &b"\xc3\xa9"[..])));
    assert_eq!(model.tag_name(model.first_child(root).unwrap()), Some(&b"x:thing"[..]));
    let span = model.source_span(root).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(&source[span.offset..span.offset + span.length], b"<svg x:unknown='v&' title='\xc3\xa9'><x:thing/></svg>");
    assert_eq!(model.source(), source);
}

#[test]
fn parse_errors_keep_xml_categories_and_offsets() {
    let mismatch = parse_document(b"<svg><g></svg>").unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(mismatch.error, DocumentError::Parse);
    assert_eq!(mismatch.diagnostic.category, XmlError::MismatchedTag);
    assert_eq!(mismatch.diagnostic.offset, 8);

    let invalid_utf8 = parse_document(b"<svg>\xff</svg>").unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(invalid_utf8.error, DocumentError::Parse);
    assert_eq!(invalid_utf8.diagnostic.category, XmlError::InvalidUtf8);
    assert_eq!(invalid_utf8.diagnostic.offset, 5);

    let invalid_character = parse_document(b"<svg>\0</svg>").unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(invalid_character.error, DocumentError::Parse);
    assert_eq!(invalid_character.diagnostic.category, XmlError::InvalidCharacter);
    assert_eq!(invalid_character.diagnostic.offset, 5);

    let duplicate = parse_document(b"<svg a='1' a='2'/>").unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(duplicate.error, DocumentError::Parse);
    assert_eq!(duplicate.diagnostic.category, XmlError::DuplicateAttribute);
    assert_eq!(duplicate.diagnostic.offset, 11);
}

#[test]
fn input_depth_and_actual_token_storage_limits_map_without_success_hooks() {
    let mut oversized = Vec::new();
    oversized.try_reserve_exact(vexel_xml::MAX_INPUT_BYTES + 1).unwrap();
    oversized.resize(vexel_xml::MAX_INPUT_BYTES + 1, b' ');
    let too_large = parse_document(&oversized).unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(too_large.error, DocumentError::Limit);
    assert_eq!(too_large.diagnostic.category, XmlError::InputLimit);
    assert_eq!(too_large.diagnostic.offset, 0);

    let mut deep = Vec::new();
    for _ in 0..=256 { deep.extend_from_slice(b"<x>"); }
    for _ in 0..=256 { deep.extend_from_slice(b"</x>"); }
    let depth_error = parse_document(&deep).unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(depth_error.error, DocumentError::Limit);
    assert_eq!(depth_error.diagnostic.category, XmlError::DepthLimit);
    assert_eq!(depth_error.diagnostic.offset, 256 * 3);

    let at_capacity = parse_document_with_storage(b"<svg/>", size_of::<XmlToken>()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(at_capacity.node_count(), 1);
    let partial_byte_capacity = parse_document_with_storage(b"<svg/>", size_of::<XmlToken>() * 2 - 1).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(partial_byte_capacity.node_count(), 1);
    let exhausted = parse_document_with_storage(b"<svg><a/><b/></svg>", size_of::<XmlToken>() * 3).unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(exhausted.error, DocumentError::ResourceExhausted);
    assert_eq!(exhausted.diagnostic.category, XmlError::OutputExhausted);
    assert_eq!(exhausted.diagnostic.offset, 13);
    let below_one_token = parse_document_with_storage(b"<svg/>", size_of::<XmlToken>() - 1).unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(below_one_token.error, DocumentError::ResourceExhausted);
}

#[test]
fn production_token_storage_cap_matches_original_boundary_case() {
    let token_capacity = (64 * 1024 * 1024) / size_of::<XmlToken>();
    assert!(token_capacity < crate::model::MAX_NODES);
    let child_bytes = token_capacity.checked_mul(4).unwrap();
    let total_bytes = 5usize.checked_add(child_bytes).unwrap().checked_add(6).unwrap();
    let mut source = Vec::new();
    source.try_reserve_exact(total_bytes).unwrap();
    source.extend_from_slice(b"<svg>");
    for _ in 0..token_capacity { source.extend_from_slice(b"<a/>"); }
    source.extend_from_slice(b"</svg>");
    let exhausted = parse_document(&source).unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(exhausted.error, DocumentError::ResourceExhausted);
    assert_eq!(exhausted.diagnostic.category, XmlError::OutputExhausted);
    let expected_offset = 5 + (token_capacity - 1) * 4;
    assert_eq!(exhausted.diagnostic.offset, expected_offset);
}

}

/// Index data shared by borrowed and Arc-owned source models.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub(crate) struct DocumentCore {
    pub(crate) id: u64,
    pub(crate) nodes: Vec<Node>,
    pub(crate) attributes: Vec<Attribute>,
    pub(crate) live_node_count: usize,
    pub(crate) root: Option<u32>,
}

impl DocumentCore {
    pub(crate) fn from_parts(
        id: u64,
        nodes: Vec<Node>,
        attributes: Vec<Attribute>,
        root: Option<u32>,
    ) -> Self {
        let live_node_count = nodes.len();
        Self { id, nodes, attributes, live_node_count, root }
    }

    pub fn document_id(&self) -> u64 { self.id }
    pub fn node_count(&self) -> usize { self.nodes.len() }
    pub fn live_node_count(&self) -> usize { self.live_node_count }

    pub fn root(&self) -> Option<DocumentHandle> {
        let slot = self.root?;
        self.nodes.get(slot as usize).filter(|node| node.live)?;
        Some(self.handle(slot))
    }

    pub fn first_child(&self, parent: DocumentHandle) -> Option<DocumentHandle> {
        let node = self.resolve(parent)?;
        let mut child = node.first_child;
        while child != NO_SLOT {
            let current = self.nodes.get(child as usize)?;
            if current.live { return Some(self.handle(child)); }
            child = current.next_sibling;
        }
        None
    }

    pub fn next_sibling(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<DocumentHandle> {
        let node = self.resolve(handle)?;
        let mut sibling = node.next_sibling;
        while sibling != NO_SLOT {
            let current = self.nodes.get(sibling as usize)?;
            if current.live { return Some(self.handle(sibling)); }
            sibling = current.next_sibling;
        }
        None
    }

    pub fn parent(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<DocumentHandle> {
        let node = self.resolve(handle)?;
        if node.parent == NO_SLOT { return None; }
        self.nodes.get(node.parent as usize).filter(|parent| parent.live)?;
        Some(self.handle(node.parent))
    }

    pub fn attribute_count(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> usize {
        self.resolve(handle).map_or(0, |node| node.attribute_count)
    }

    fn attribute_spans(&self, handle: DocumentHandle, index: usize) -> Option<(vexel_xml::XmlSpan, vexel_xml::XmlSpan)> {
        let node = self.resolve(handle)?;
        if index >= node.attribute_count { return None; }
        let attribute = self.attributes.get(node.first_attribute.checked_add(index)?)?;
        Some((attribute.name, attribute.value))
    }

    pub fn depth(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<usize> {
        Some(self.resolve(handle)?.depth)
    }

    pub fn node_at(&self, slot: usize) -> Option<DocumentHandle> {
        let index = u32::try_from(slot).ok()?;
        self.nodes.get(slot).filter(|node| node.live)?;
        Some(self.handle(index))
    }

    pub fn source_span(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<DocumentSourceSpan> {
        Some(self.resolve(handle)?.source)
    }

    /// Removes a node and all descendants. Slots remain stable; each live
    /// generation advances so previously issued handles cannot resolve.
    pub fn remove_subtree(&mut self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> bool {
        if self.resolve(handle).is_none() { return false; }
        for index in 0..self.nodes.len() {
            if !self.is_descendant_or_self(index, handle.slot as usize) { continue; }
            let node = &mut self.nodes[index];
            if node.live {
                node.live = false;
                self.live_node_count -= 1;
                if node.generation != u32::MAX { node.generation += 1; }
            }
        }
        if self.root == Some(handle.slot) { self.root = None; }
        true
    }

    fn is_descendant_or_self(&self, index: usize, ancestor: usize) -> bool {
        let mut current = index;
        loop {
            if current == ancestor { return true; }
            let Some(node) = self.nodes.get(current) else { return false; };
            if node.parent == NO_SLOT { return false; }
            current = node.parent as usize;
        }
    }

    fn resolve(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<&Node> {
        if handle.document_id != self.id { return None; }
        let node = self.nodes.get(handle.slot as usize)?;
        (node.live && node.generation == handle.generation).then_some(node)
    }

    fn handle(&self, slot: u32) -> DocumentHandle {
        DocumentHandle { document_id: self.id, slot, generation: self.nodes[slot as usize].generation }
    }
}

/// An immutable-source document with safely owned indexes and mutable live
/// state. The source borrow must outlive this model.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct DocumentModel<'source> {
    pub(crate) source: &'source [u8],
    pub(crate) core: DocumentCore,
}

/// A source-owning model. Cloning this value is intentionally unsupported so
/// each document identity has exactly one owner and one live-state table.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct OwnedDocumentModel {
    pub(crate) source: Arc<Vec<u8>>,
    pub(crate) core: DocumentCore,
}

macro_rules! document_query_methods {
    ($bytes:ty) => {
            pub fn document_id(&self) -> u64 { self.core.document_id() }
            pub fn source(&self) -> $bytes { &self.source }
            pub fn node_count(&self) -> usize { self.core.node_count() }
            pub fn live_node_count(&self) -> usize { self.core.live_node_count() }
            pub fn root(&self) -> Option<DocumentHandle> { self.core.root() }
            pub fn first_child(&self, parent: DocumentHandle) -> Option<DocumentHandle> { self.core.first_child(parent) }
            pub fn next_sibling(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<DocumentHandle> { self.core.next_sibling(handle) }
            pub fn parent(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<DocumentHandle> { self.core.parent(handle) }
            pub fn tag_name(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<$bytes> {
                self.core.resolve(handle)?.name.slice(&self.source)
            }
            pub fn attribute_count(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> usize { self.core.attribute_count(handle) }
            pub fn attribute_at(&self, handle: DocumentHandle, index: usize) -> Option<($bytes, $bytes)> {
                let (name, value) = self.core.attribute_spans(handle, index)?;
                Some((name.slice(&self.source)?, value.slice(&self.source)?))
            }
            pub fn depth(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<usize> { self.core.depth(handle) }
            pub fn node_at(&self, slot: usize) -> Option<DocumentHandle> { self.core.node_at(slot) }
            pub fn source_span(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<DocumentSourceSpan> { self.core.source_span(handle) }
            pub fn remove_subtree(&mut self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> bool { self.core.remove_subtree(handle) }
    };
}

impl<'source> DocumentModel<'source> {
    document_query_methods!(&'source [u8]);

pub fn parse_document(source: &[u8]) -> Result<DocumentModel<'_>, DocumentParseError> {

}

pub(crate) fn parse_document_with_storage(source: &[u8], storage_limit: usize) -> Result<DocumentModel<'_>, DocumentParseError> {
    let core = parse_core(source, vexel_xml::MAX_INPUT_BYTES, storage_limit, &mut || false)
        .map_err(|failure| match failure { BuildFailure::Parse(error) => error, BuildFailure::Canceled { .. } => unreachable!("disabled cancellation") })?;
    Ok(DocumentModel { source, core })
}

pub fn parse_document_large(source: &[u8]) -> Result<DocumentModel<'_>, LargeDocumentError> {

pub fn parse_document_large_cancellable<C: FnMut() -> bool>(source: &[u8], mut cancel: C) -> Result<DocumentModel<'_>, LargeDocumentError> {
    let core = parse_core(source, LARGE_SOURCE_LIMIT, TOKEN_STORAGE_LIMIT, &mut cancel)
        .map_err(|failure| match failure { BuildFailure::Parse(error) => LargeDocumentError::Parse(error), BuildFailure::Canceled { offset } => LargeDocumentError::Canceled { offset } })?;

pub fn parse_owned_document(source: &Arc<Vec<u8>>) -> Result<OwnedDocumentModel, OwnedParseError> {

        .map_err(|failure| match failure { BuildFailure::Parse(error) => OwnedParseError::Parse(error), BuildFailure::Canceled { offset } => OwnedParseError::Canceled { offset } })?;
    Ok(OwnedDocumentModel { source: Arc::clone(source), core })
}

pub fn parse_owned_document_large(source: &Arc<Vec<u8>>) -> Result<OwnedDocumentModel, OwnedParseError> {

pub fn parse_owned_document_large_cancellable<C: FnMut() -> bool>(source: &Arc<Vec<u8>>, mut cancel: C) -> Result<OwnedDocumentModel, OwnedParseError> {
    let core = parse_core(source.as_slice(), LARGE_SOURCE_LIMIT, TOKEN_STORAGE_LIMIT, &mut cancel)
        .map_err(|failure| match failure { BuildFailure::Parse(error) => OwnedParseError::Parse(error), BuildFailure::Canceled { offset } => OwnedParseError::Canceled { offset } })?;

fn parse_core<C: FnMut() -> bool>(source: &[u8], source_limit: usize, storage_limit: usize, cancel: &mut C) -> Result<DocumentCore, BuildFailure> {
    let parse_error = |error, diagnostic| BuildFailure::Parse(DocumentParseError { error, diagnostic });
    if storage_limit < size_of::<XmlToken>() {
        return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::ResourceExhausted, XmlDiagnostic::default()));
    }
    if source.len() > source_limit {
        return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::Limit, XmlDiagnostic { category: XmlError::InputLimit, offset: 0 }));
    }

    let mut stream = XmlTokenStream::new(source, storage_limit).map_err(|_| parse_error(DocumentError::OutOfMemory, XmlDiagnostic::default()))?;
    if stream.token_storage_bytes() > storage_limit
        || stream.open_name_storage_bytes() > MAX_OPEN_NAME_BYTES
    {
        return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::OutOfMemory, XmlDiagnostic::default()));
    }
    let status = loop {
        let status = stream.step_with_cancel(STEP_BYTES, cancel);
        if stream.token_storage_bytes() > storage_limit
            || stream.open_name_storage_bytes() > MAX_OPEN_NAME_BYTES
        {
            return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::OutOfMemory, stream.result().diagnostic));
        }
        if status != StreamStatus::Ok { break status; }
    };
    let result = stream.result();
    if status == StreamStatus::Canceled { return Err(BuildFailure::Canceled { offset: 0 }); }
    if status != StreamStatus::Complete || result.diagnostic.category != XmlError::None {
        let error = match result.diagnostic.category {
            XmlError::InputLimit | XmlError::NodeLimit | XmlError::DepthLimit | XmlError::AttributeLimit
            | XmlError::TextLimit => DocumentError::Limit,
            XmlError::OutputExhausted => DocumentError::ResourceExhausted,
            XmlError::None => DocumentError::OutOfMemory,
            _ => DocumentError::Parse,
        };
        return Err(parse_error(error, result.diagnostic));
    }

    if result.element_count == 0 || result.element_count > MAX_NODES || result.element_count > u32::MAX as usize
        || result.attribute_count > vexel_xml::MAX_TOTAL_ATTRIBUTES
        || checked_table_bytes::<Node>(result.element_count).is_none()
        || checked_table_bytes::<Attribute>(result.attribute_count).is_none()
    {
        return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::Limit, result.diagnostic));
    }
    let tokens = stream.take().ok_or_else(|| parse_error(DocumentError::Parse, result.diagnostic))?;
    if stream.token_storage_bytes() != 0 {
        return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::Parse, result.diagnostic));
    }

    let id = allocate_document_id().ok_or_else(|| parse_error(DocumentError::IdExhausted, result.diagnostic))?;
    let (nodes, attributes, root) = build_tables(source, &tokens, result.element_count, result.attribute_count, cancel)
        .map_err(|failure| match failure { TableFailure::Parse(error) => parse_error(error, result.diagnostic), TableFailure::Canceled { offset } => BuildFailure::Canceled { offset } })?;
    Ok(DocumentCore::from_parts(id, nodes, attributes, Some(root)))
}

enum TableFailure { Parse(DocumentError), Canceled { offset: usize } }
impl From<DocumentError> for TableFailure { fn from(error: DocumentError) -> Self { Self::Parse(error) } }

fn build_tables(
    source: &[u8],
    tokens: &[XmlToken],
    node_count: usize,
    attribute_count: usize,
    cancel: &mut impl FnMut() -> bool,
) -> Result<(Vec<Node>, Vec<Attribute>, u32), TableFailure> {
    let parse_error = |error| TableFailure::Parse(error);
    let mut nodes: Vec<Node> = Vec::new();
    nodes.try_reserve_exact(node_count).map_err(|_| parse_error(DocumentError::OutOfMemory))?;
    if nodes.capacity() > MAX_NODES { return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::OutOfMemory)); }
    let mut attributes: Vec<Attribute> = Vec::new();
    attributes.try_reserve_exact(attribute_count).map_err(|_| parse_error(DocumentError::OutOfMemory))?;
    if attributes.capacity() > vexel_xml::MAX_TOTAL_ATTRIBUTES { return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::OutOfMemory)); }
    let mut stack: Vec<u32> = Vec::new();
    stack.try_reserve_exact(MAX_DEPTH).map_err(|_| parse_error(DocumentError::OutOfMemory))?;
    if stack.capacity() > MAX_DEPTH { return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::OutOfMemory)); }

    let mut root = None;
    let mut index = 0usize;
    while index < tokens.len() {
        if cancel() { return Err(TableFailure::Canceled { offset: tokens.get(index).map_or(source.len(), |token| token.source.offset) }); }
        let token = tokens[index];
        match token.kind {
            TokenKind::StartElement | TokenKind::EmptyElement => {
                if nodes.len() >= node_count || nodes.len() >= MAX_NODES || nodes.len() >= u32::MAX as usize
                    || token.name.slice(source).is_none() || checked_span(token.source, source).is_none()
                {
                    return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::Parse));
                }
                let slot = u32::try_from(nodes.len()).map_err(|_| parse_error(DocumentError::Limit))?;
                let parent = stack.last().copied().unwrap_or(no_slot());
                let depth = stack.len();
                let mut node = Node {
                    name: token.name,
                    source: DocumentSourceSpan { offset: token.source.offset, length: token.source.length },
                    first_attribute: attributes.len(),
                    depth,
                    parent,
                    ..Node::default()
                };
                if parent != no_slot() {
                    let parent_index = parent as usize;
                    let parent_node = nodes.get(parent_index).ok_or_else(|| parse_error(DocumentError::Parse))?;
                    let previous_last = parent_node.last_child;
                    if parent_node.first_child == no_slot() { nodes[parent_index].first_child = slot; }
                    else {
                        let previous = nodes.get_mut(previous_last as usize).ok_or_else(|| parse_error(DocumentError::Parse))?;
                        previous.next_sibling = slot;
                    }
                    nodes[parent_index].last_child = slot;
                } else if parent == no_slot() {
                    if root.replace(slot).is_some() { return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::Parse)); }
                } else {
                    return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::Parse));
                }

                index += 1;
                while let Some(attribute) = tokens.get(index).filter(|next| next.kind == TokenKind::Attribute) {
                    if cancel() { return Err(TableFailure::Canceled { offset: attribute.source.offset }); }
                    if attributes.len() >= attribute_count || attribute.name.slice(source).is_none()
                        || attribute.value.slice(source).is_none() || checked_span(attribute.source, source).is_none()
                    {
                        return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::Parse));
                    }
                    attributes.push(Attribute { name: attribute.name, value: attribute.value });
                    node.attribute_count += 1;
                    index += 1;
                }
                nodes.push(node);
                if token.kind == TokenKind::StartElement {
                    if stack.len() >= MAX_DEPTH { return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::Limit)); }
                    stack.push(slot);
                }
            }
            TokenKind::EndElement => {
                let Some(slot) = stack.pop() else { return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::Parse)); };
                let node = nodes.get_mut(slot as usize).ok_or_else(|| parse_error(DocumentError::Parse))?;
                let end = token.source.offset.checked_add(token.source.length).ok_or_else(|| parse_error(DocumentError::Parse))?;
                let node_end = node.source.offset.checked_add(node.source.length).ok_or_else(|| parse_error(DocumentError::Parse))?;
                if node.source.offset > token.source.offset || end < node_end || end > source.len()
                    || token.name.slice(source).is_none()
                {
                    return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::Parse));
                }
                node.source.length = end.checked_sub(node.source.offset).ok_or(DocumentError::Parse)?;
                index += 1;
            }
            _ => index += 1,
        }
    }
    if !stack.is_empty() || nodes.len() != node_count || attributes.len() != attribute_count {
        return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::Parse));
    }
    Ok((nodes, attributes, root.ok_or(DocumentError::Parse)?))
}

fn checked_span<'a>(span: XmlSpan, source: &'a [u8]) -> Option<&'a [u8]> {
    let end = span.offset.checked_add(span.length)?;
    source.get(span.offset..end)
}

/// An immutable-source document with safely owned indexes and mutable live
/// state. The source borrow must outlive this model.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct DocumentModel<'source> {
    pub(crate) source: &'source [u8],
    pub(crate) id: u64,
    pub(crate) nodes: Vec<Node>,
    pub(crate) attributes: Vec<Attribute>,
    pub(crate) live_node_count: usize,
    pub(crate) root: Option<u32>,
}

impl<'source> DocumentModel<'source> {
    pub(crate) fn from_parts(
        source: &'source [u8],
        id: u64,
        nodes: Vec<Node>,
        attributes: Vec<Attribute>,
        root: Option<u32>,
    ) -> Self {
        let live_node_count = nodes.len();
        Self { source, id, nodes, attributes, live_node_count, root }
    }

    pub fn document_id(&self) -> u64 { self.id }
    pub fn source(&self) -> &'source [u8] { self.source }
    pub fn node_count(&self) -> usize { self.nodes.len() }
    pub fn live_node_count(&self) -> usize { self.live_node_count }

    pub fn root(&self) -> Option<DocumentHandle> {
        let slot = self.root?;
        self.nodes.get(slot as usize).filter(|node| node.live)?;
        Some(self.handle(slot))
    }

    pub fn first_child(&self, parent: DocumentHandle) -> Option<DocumentHandle> {
        let node = self.resolve(parent)?;
        let mut child = node.first_child;
        while child != NO_SLOT {
            let current = self.nodes.get(child as usize)?;
            if current.live { return Some(self.handle(child)); }
            child = current.next_sibling;
        }
        None
    }

    pub fn next_sibling(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<DocumentHandle> {
        let node = self.resolve(handle)?;
        let mut sibling = node.next_sibling;
        while sibling != NO_SLOT {
            let current = self.nodes.get(sibling as usize)?;
            if current.live { return Some(self.handle(sibling)); }
            sibling = current.next_sibling;
        }
        None
    }

    pub fn parent(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<DocumentHandle> {
        let node = self.resolve(handle)?;
        if node.parent == NO_SLOT { return None; }
        self.nodes.get(node.parent as usize).filter(|parent| parent.live)?;
        Some(self.handle(node.parent))
    }

    pub fn tag_name(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<&'source [u8]> {
        self.resolve(handle)?.name.slice(self.source)
    }

    pub fn attribute_count(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> usize {
        self.resolve(handle).map_or(0, |node| node.attribute_count)
    }

    pub fn attribute_at(&self, handle: DocumentHandle, index: usize) -> Option<(&'source [u8], &'source [u8])> {
        let node = self.resolve(handle)?;
        if index >= node.attribute_count { return None; }
        let attribute = self.attributes.get(node.first_attribute.checked_add(index)?)?;
        Some((attribute.name.slice(self.source)?, attribute.value.slice(self.source)?))
    }

    pub fn depth(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<usize> {
        Some(self.resolve(handle)?.depth)
    }

    pub fn node_at(&self, slot: usize) -> Option<DocumentHandle> {
        let index = u32::try_from(slot).ok()?;
        self.nodes.get(slot).filter(|node| node.live)?;
        Some(self.handle(index))
    }

    pub fn source_span(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<DocumentSourceSpan> {
        Some(self.resolve(handle)?.source)
    }

    /// Removes a node and all descendants. Slots remain stable; each live
    /// generation advances so previously issued handles cannot resolve.
    pub fn remove_subtree(&mut self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> bool {
        if self.resolve(handle).is_none() { return false; }
        for index in 0..self.nodes.len() {
            if !self.is_descendant_or_self(index, handle.slot as usize) { continue; }
            let node = &mut self.nodes[index];
            if node.live {
                node.live = false;
                self.live_node_count -= 1;
                if node.generation != u32::MAX { node.generation += 1; }
            }
        }
        if self.root == Some(handle.slot) { self.root = None; }
        true
    }

    fn is_descendant_or_self(&self, index: usize, ancestor: usize) -> bool {
        let mut current = index;
        loop {
            if current == ancestor { return true; }
            let Some(node) = self.nodes.get(current) else { return false; };
            if node.parent == NO_SLOT { return false; }
            current = node.parent as usize;
        }
    }

    fn resolve(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<&Node> {
        if handle.document_id != self.id { return None; }
        let node = self.nodes.get(handle.slot as usize)?;
        (node.live && node.generation == handle.generation).then_some(node)
    }

    fn handle(&self, slot: u32) -> DocumentHandle {
        DocumentHandle { document_id: self.id, slot, generation: self.nodes[slot as usize].generation }
    }
}

    count.checked_mul(size_of::<T>())
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct DocumentParseError {
    pub error: DocumentError,
    pub diagnostic: XmlDiagnostic,
}

pub fn parse_document(source: &[u8]) -> Result<DocumentModel<'_>, DocumentParseError> {
    parse_document_with_storage(source, TOKEN_STORAGE_LIMIT)
}

pub(crate) fn parse_document_with_storage(source: &[u8], storage_limit: usize) -> Result<DocumentModel<'_>, DocumentParseError> {
    if storage_limit < size_of::<XmlToken>() {
        return Err(DocumentParseError { error: DocumentError::ResourceExhausted, diagnostic: XmlDiagnostic::default() });
    }
    if source.len() > vexel_xml::MAX_INPUT_BYTES {
        return Err(DocumentParseError {
            error: DocumentError::Limit,
            diagnostic: XmlDiagnostic { category: XmlError::InputLimit, offset: 0 },
        });
    }

    let mut stream = XmlTokenStream::new(source, storage_limit).map_err(|_| DocumentParseError {
        error: DocumentError::OutOfMemory,
        diagnostic: XmlDiagnostic::default(),
    })?;
    if stream.token_storage_bytes() > storage_limit
        || stream.open_name_storage_bytes() > MAX_OPEN_NAME_BYTES
    {
        return Err(DocumentParseError { error: DocumentError::OutOfMemory, diagnostic: XmlDiagnostic::default() });
    }
    let status = loop {
        let status = stream.step(STEP_BYTES, false);
        if stream.token_storage_bytes() > storage_limit
            || stream.open_name_storage_bytes() > MAX_OPEN_NAME_BYTES
        {
            return Err(DocumentParseError { error: DocumentError::OutOfMemory, diagnostic: stream.result().diagnostic });
        }
        if status != StreamStatus::Ok { break status; }
    };
    let result = stream.result();
    if status != StreamStatus::Complete || result.diagnostic.category != XmlError::None {
        let error = match result.diagnostic.category {
            XmlError::InputLimit | XmlError::NodeLimit | XmlError::DepthLimit | XmlError::AttributeLimit
            | XmlError::TextLimit => DocumentError::Limit,
            XmlError::OutputExhausted => DocumentError::ResourceExhausted,
            XmlError::None => DocumentError::OutOfMemory,
            _ => DocumentError::Parse,
        };
        return Err(DocumentParseError { error, diagnostic: result.diagnostic });
    }

    if result.element_count == 0 || result.element_count > MAX_NODES || result.element_count > u32::MAX as usize
        || result.attribute_count > vexel_xml::MAX_TOTAL_ATTRIBUTES
        || checked_table_bytes::<Node>(result.element_count).is_none()
        || checked_table_bytes::<Attribute>(result.attribute_count).is_none()
    {
        return Err(DocumentParseError { error: DocumentError::Limit, diagnostic: result.diagnostic });
    }
    let tokens = stream.take().ok_or(DocumentParseError {
        error: DocumentError::Parse,
        diagnostic: result.diagnostic,
    })?;
    if stream.token_storage_bytes() != 0 {
        return Err(DocumentParseError { error: DocumentError::Parse, diagnostic: result.diagnostic });
    }

    let id = allocate_document_id().ok_or(DocumentParseError {
        error: DocumentError::IdExhausted,
        diagnostic: result.diagnostic,
    })?;
    let (nodes, attributes, root) = build_tables(source, &tokens, result.element_count, result.attribute_count)
        .map_err(|error| DocumentParseError { error, diagnostic: result.diagnostic })?;
    Ok(DocumentModel::from_parts(source, id, nodes, attributes, Some(root)))
}

fn build_tables(
    source: &[u8],
    tokens: &[XmlToken],
    node_count: usize,
    attribute_count: usize,
) -> Result<(Vec<Node>, Vec<Attribute>, u32), DocumentError> {
    let mut nodes: Vec<Node> = Vec::new();
    nodes.try_reserve_exact(node_count).map_err(|_| DocumentError::OutOfMemory)?;
    if nodes.capacity() > MAX_NODES { return Err(DocumentError::OutOfMemory); }
    let mut attributes: Vec<Attribute> = Vec::new();
    attributes.try_reserve_exact(attribute_count).map_err(|_| DocumentError::OutOfMemory)?;
    if attributes.capacity() > vexel_xml::MAX_TOTAL_ATTRIBUTES { return Err(DocumentError::OutOfMemory); }
    let mut stack: Vec<u32> = Vec::new();
    stack.try_reserve_exact(MAX_DEPTH).map_err(|_| DocumentError::OutOfMemory)?;
    if stack.capacity() > MAX_DEPTH { return Err(DocumentError::OutOfMemory); }

    let mut root = None;
    let mut index = 0usize;
    while index < tokens.len() {
        let token = tokens[index];
        match token.kind {
            TokenKind::StartElement | TokenKind::EmptyElement => {
                if nodes.len() >= node_count || nodes.len() >= MAX_NODES || nodes.len() >= u32::MAX as usize
                    || token.name.slice(source).is_none() || checked_span(token.source, source).is_none()
                {
                    return Err(DocumentError::Parse);
                }
                let slot = u32::try_from(nodes.len()).map_err(|_| DocumentError::Limit)?;
                let parent = stack.last().copied().unwrap_or(no_slot());
                let depth = stack.len();
                let mut node = Node {
                    name: token.name,
                    source: DocumentSourceSpan { offset: token.source.offset, length: token.source.length },
                    first_attribute: attributes.len(),
                    depth,
                    parent,
                    ..Node::default()
                };
                if parent != no_slot() {
                    let parent_index = parent as usize;
                    let parent_node = nodes.get(parent_index).ok_or(DocumentError::Parse)?;
                    let previous_last = parent_node.last_child;
                    if parent_node.first_child == no_slot() { nodes[parent_index].first_child = slot; }
                    else {
                        let previous = nodes.get_mut(previous_last as usize).ok_or(DocumentError::Parse)?;
                        previous.next_sibling = slot;
                    }
                    nodes[parent_index].last_child = slot;
                } else if parent == no_slot() {
                    if root.replace(slot).is_some() { return Err(DocumentError::Parse); }
                } else {
                    return Err(DocumentError::Parse);
                }

                index += 1;
                while let Some(attribute) = tokens.get(index).filter(|next| next.kind == TokenKind::Attribute) {
                    if attributes.len() >= attribute_count || attribute.name.slice(source).is_none()
                        || attribute.value.slice(source).is_none() || checked_span(attribute.source, source).is_none()
                    {
                        return Err(DocumentError::Parse);
                    }
                    attributes.push(Attribute { name: attribute.name, value: attribute.value });
                    node.attribute_count += 1;
                    index += 1;
                }
                nodes.push(node);
                if token.kind == TokenKind::StartElement {
                    if stack.len() >= MAX_DEPTH { return Err(DocumentError::Limit); }
                    stack.push(slot);
                }
            }
            TokenKind::EndElement => {
                let Some(slot) = stack.pop() else { return Err(DocumentError::Parse); };
                let node = nodes.get_mut(slot as usize).ok_or(DocumentError::Parse)?;
                let end = token.source.offset.checked_add(token.source.length).ok_or(DocumentError::Parse)?;
                let node_end = node.source.offset.checked_add(node.source.length).ok_or(DocumentError::Parse)?;
                if node.source.offset > token.source.offset || end < node_end || end > source.len()
                    || token.name.slice(source).is_none()
                {
                    return Err(DocumentError::Parse);
                }
                node.source.length = end.checked_sub(node.source.offset).ok_or(DocumentError::Parse)?;
                index += 1;
            }
            _ => index += 1,
        }
    }
    if !stack.is_empty() || nodes.len() != node_count || attributes.len() != attribute_count {
        return Err(DocumentError::Parse);
    }
    Ok((nodes, attributes, root.ok_or(DocumentError::Parse)?))
}

fn checked_span<'a>(span: XmlSpan, source: &'a [u8]) -> Option<&'a [u8]> {
    let end = span.offset.checked_add(span.length)?;
    source.get(span.offset..end)
}

const SOURCE: &[u8] = b"<?xml version='1.0'?>\r\n<svg xmlns='urn:svg' xmlns:i='urn:inkscape'><g i:label='keep'><rect id='one'/><i:unknown><path d='M0 0'/></i:unknown></g><circle/></svg>\n";

fn name_is(model: &crate::DocumentModel<'_>, handle: crate::DocumentHandle, expected: &[u8]) -> bool {
    model.tag_name(handle) == Some(expected)
}

#[test]
fn original_fixture_preserves_source_spans_attributes_and_tree_queries() {
    let original = SOURCE.to_vec();
    let first = parse_document(SOURCE).expect("valid source");
    let second = parse_document(SOURCE).expect("same source can open twice");
    assert_eq!(first.node_count(), 6);
    assert_eq!(first.live_node_count(), 6);
    assert_ne!(first.document_id(), second.document_id());
    assert_eq!(first.source(), SOURCE);

    let root = first.root().expect("root");
    assert!(name_is(&first, root, b"svg"));
    let group = first.first_child(root).expect("group");
    assert_eq!(first.first_child(root), Some(group));
    assert!(name_is(&first, group, b"g"));
    assert_eq!(first.parent(group), Some(root));
    assert_eq!(first.depth(root), Some(0));
    assert_eq!(first.depth(group), Some(1));
    assert_eq!(first.node_at(0), Some(root));
    assert_eq!(first.node_at(first.node_count()), None);

    let rectangle = first.first_child(group).expect("rect");
    assert!(name_is(&first, rectangle, b"rect"));
    let unknown = first.next_sibling(rectangle).expect("unknown editor node");
    assert!(name_is(&first, unknown, b"i:unknown"));
    let path = first.first_child(unknown).expect("path");
    assert!(name_is(&first, path, b"path"));
    assert_eq!(first.depth(path), Some(3));
    let circle = first.next_sibling(group).expect("circle");
    assert!(name_is(&first, circle, b"circle"));
    assert_eq!(first.next_sibling(circle), None);
    assert_eq!(first.next_sibling(root), None);

    assert_eq!(first.attribute_count(group), 1);
    assert_eq!(first.attribute_count(root), 2);
    assert_eq!(first.attribute_at(group, 0), Some((&b"i:label"[..], &b"keep"[..])));
    assert_eq!(first.attribute_at(group, 1), None);
    assert_eq!(first.attribute_at(root, 0), Some((&b"xmlns"[..], &b"urn:svg"[..])));
    let group_span = first.source_span(group).expect("group span");
    let expected_group = b"<g i:label='keep'><rect id='one'/><i:unknown><path d='M0 0'/></i:unknown></g>";
    assert_eq!(&SOURCE[group_span.offset..group_span.offset + group_span.length], expected_group);
    let circle_span = first.source_span(circle).expect("empty element span");
    assert_eq!(&SOURCE[circle_span.offset..circle_span.offset + circle_span.length], b"<circle/>");
    assert_eq!(SOURCE, original.as_slice());
}

#[test]
fn foreign_wrong_generation_and_deleted_handles_are_rejected() {
    let mut first = parse_document(SOURCE).unwrap();
    let second = parse_document(SOURCE).unwrap();
    let root = first.root().unwrap();
    let group = first.first_child(root).unwrap();
    let rectangle = first.first_child(group).unwrap();
    let unknown = first.next_sibling(rectangle).unwrap();
    let path = first.first_child(unknown).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(second.tag_name(root), None);
    assert_eq!(first.tag_name(crate::DocumentHandle { slot: u32::MAX, ..root }), None);
    assert_eq!(first.tag_name(crate::DocumentHandle { generation: 0, ..root }), None);
    assert_eq!(first.tag_name(crate::DocumentHandle { generation: root.generation + 1, ..root }), None);
    assert!(first.remove_subtree(group));
    assert_eq!(first.live_node_count(), 2);
    for stale in [group, rectangle, unknown, path] {
        assert_eq!(first.tag_name(stale), None);
        assert_eq!(first.source_span(stale), None);
        assert_eq!(first.parent(stale), None);
    }
    assert_eq!(first.first_child(root).map(|handle| first.tag_name(handle)), Some(Some(&b"circle"[..])));
    assert!(!first.remove_subtree(group));
    assert!(first.remove_subtree(root));
    assert_eq!(first.live_node_count(), 0);
    assert_eq!(first.root(), None);
    assert_eq!(first.node_at(0), None);
    assert_eq!(first.source(), SOURCE);
}

#[test]
fn input_depth_and_actual_token_storage_limits_map_without_success_hooks() {
    let mut oversized = Vec::new();
    oversized.try_reserve_exact(vexel_xml::MAX_INPUT_BYTES + 1).unwrap();
    oversized.resize(vexel_xml::MAX_INPUT_BYTES + 1, b' ');
    let too_large = parse_document(&oversized).unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(too_large.error, DocumentError::Limit);
    assert_eq!(too_large.diagnostic.category, XmlError::InputLimit);
    assert_eq!(too_large.diagnostic.offset, 0);

    let mut deep = Vec::new();
    for _ in 0..=256 { deep.extend_from_slice(b"<x>"); }
    for _ in 0..=256 { deep.extend_from_slice(b"</x>"); }
    let depth_error = parse_document(&deep).unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(depth_error.error, DocumentError::Limit);
    assert_eq!(depth_error.diagnostic.category, XmlError::DepthLimit);
    assert_eq!(depth_error.diagnostic.offset, 256 * 3);

    let at_capacity = parse_document_with_storage(b"<svg/>", size_of::<XmlToken>()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(at_capacity.node_count(), 1);
    let partial_byte_capacity = parse_document_with_storage(b"<svg/>", size_of::<XmlToken>() * 2 - 1).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(partial_byte_capacity.node_count(), 1);
    let exhausted = parse_document_with_storage(b"<svg><a/><b/></svg>", size_of::<XmlToken>() * 3).unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(exhausted.error, DocumentError::ResourceExhausted);
    assert_eq!(exhausted.diagnostic.category, XmlError::OutputExhausted);
    assert_eq!(exhausted.diagnostic.offset, 13);
    let below_one_token = parse_document_with_storage(b"<svg/>", size_of::<XmlToken>() - 1).unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(below_one_token.error, DocumentError::ResourceExhausted);
}

#[test]
fn production_token_storage_cap_matches_original_boundary_case() {
    let token_capacity = (64 * 1024 * 1024) / size_of::<XmlToken>();
    assert!(token_capacity < crate::model::MAX_NODES);
    let child_bytes = token_capacity.checked_mul(4).unwrap();
    let total_bytes = 5usize.checked_add(child_bytes).unwrap().checked_add(6).unwrap();
    let mut source = Vec::new();
    source.try_reserve_exact(total_bytes).unwrap();
    source.extend_from_slice(b"<svg>");
    for _ in 0..token_capacity { source.extend_from_slice(b"<a/>"); }
    source.extend_from_slice(b"</svg>");
    let exhausted = parse_document(&source).unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(exhausted.error, DocumentError::ResourceExhausted);
    assert_eq!(exhausted.diagnostic.category, XmlError::OutputExhausted);
    let expected_offset = 5 + (token_capacity - 1) * 4;
    assert_eq!(exhausted.diagnostic.offset, expected_offset);
}

//! Bounded XML 1.0 byte-preserving tokenizer and resumable tag reader.

use vexel_base::Span;

pub const MAX_READER_SOURCE_BYTES: usize = 1024 * 1024 * 1024;
pub const MAX_READER_STEP_BYTES: usize = 64 * 1024;
pub const MAX_READER_NAME_BYTES: usize = 4096;

/// XML 1.0 Fifth Edition `Char` production.
pub const fn is_xml_char(cp: u32) -> bool {
    cp == 0x9
        || cp == 0xa
        || cp == 0xd
        || (cp >= 0x20 && cp <= 0xd7ff)
        || (cp >= 0xe000 && cp <= 0xfffd)
        || (cp >= 0x10000 && cp <= 0x10ffff)
}

/// Decodes one strict UTF-8 scalar at `position` and returns it with the next
/// byte offset. On failure, callers retain their original position.
pub fn utf8_next(bytes: &[u8], position: usize) -> Option<(u32, usize)> {
    let first = *bytes.get(position)?;
    let (count, mut value) = match first {
        0x00..=0x7f => (1usize, u32::from(first)),
        0xc2..=0xdf => (2, u32::from(first & 0x1f)),
        0xe0..=0xef => (3, u32::from(first & 0x0f)),
        0xf0..=0xf4 => (4, u32::from(first & 0x07)),
        _ => return None,
    };
    let end = position.checked_add(count)?;
    let tail = bytes.get(position + 1..end)?;
    for &byte in tail {
        if byte & 0xc0 != 0x80 {
            return None;
        }
        value = (value << 6) | u32::from(byte & 0x3f);
    }
    let second = *tail.first().unwrap_or(&0);
    if (count == 3 && ((first == 0xe0 && second < 0xa0) || (first == 0xed && second >= 0xa0)))
        || (count == 4 && ((first == 0xf0 && second < 0x90) || (first == 0xf4 && second >= 0x90)))
        || value > 0x10ffff
        || (0xd800..=0xdfff).contains(&value)
    {
        return None;
    }
    Some((value, end))
}

/// XML 1.0 Fifth Edition `NameStartChar` production.
pub const fn is_name_start(cp: u32) -> bool {
    cp == 0x3a
        || cp == 0x5f
        || (cp >= 0x41 && cp <= 0x5a)
        || (cp >= 0x61 && cp <= 0x7a)
        || (cp >= 0xc0 && cp <= 0xd6)
        || (cp >= 0xd8 && cp <= 0xf6)
        || (cp >= 0xf8 && cp <= 0x2ff)
        || (cp >= 0x370 && cp <= 0x37d)
        || (cp >= 0x37f && cp <= 0x1fff)
        || (cp >= 0x200c && cp <= 0x200d)
        || (cp >= 0x2070 && cp <= 0x218f)
        || (cp >= 0x2c00 && cp <= 0x2fef)
        || (cp >= 0x3001 && cp <= 0xd7ff)
        || (cp >= 0xf900 && cp <= 0xfdcf)
        || (cp >= 0xfdf0 && cp <= 0xfffd)
        || (cp >= 0x10000 && cp <= 0xeffff)
}

/// XML 1.0 Fifth Edition `NameChar` production.
pub const fn is_name_char(cp: u32) -> bool {
    is_name_start(cp)
        || cp == 0x2d
        || cp == 0x2e
        || (cp >= 0x30 && cp <= 0x39)
        || cp == 0xb7
        || (cp >= 0x300 && cp <= 0x36f)
        || (cp >= 0x203f && cp <= 0x2040)
}

/// XML whitespace is exactly space, tab, line feed, and carriage return.
pub const fn is_xml_whitespace(byte: u8) -> bool {
    matches!(byte, 0x20 | 0x09 | 0x0a | 0x0d)
}

enum Probe { None, Comment, Cdata, Doctype }
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum DoctypePhase { Start, Main, Quote, Subset, SubsetQuote, Lt, Bang, BangDash, Comment, Pi }
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum DoctypeResult { More, Done, Bad }

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
struct DoctypeState {
    phase: DoctypePhase,
    quote: u8,
    run: u8,
    subset_closed: bool,
}

impl Default for DoctypeState {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self { phase: DoctypePhase::Start, quote: 0, run: 0, subset_closed: false }
    }
}

impl DoctypeState {
    fn step(&mut self, byte: u8) -> DoctypeResult {
        loop {
            match self.phase {
                DoctypePhase::Start => {
                    if !is_xml_whitespace(byte) { return DoctypeResult::Bad; }
                    self.phase = DoctypePhase::Main;
                    return DoctypeResult::More;
                }
                DoctypePhase::Main => match byte {
                    b'"' | b'\'' => { self.quote = byte; self.phase = DoctypePhase::Quote; }
                    b'[' => {
                        if self.subset_closed { return DoctypeResult::Bad; }
                        self.phase = DoctypePhase::Subset;
                    }
                    b'>' => return DoctypeResult::Done,
                    b'<' => return DoctypeResult::Bad,
                    _ => {}
                },
                DoctypePhase::Quote => if byte == self.quote { self.phase = DoctypePhase::Main; },
                DoctypePhase::Subset => match byte {
                    b'"' | b'\'' => { self.quote = byte; self.phase = DoctypePhase::SubsetQuote; }
                    b'<' => self.phase = DoctypePhase::Lt,
                    b']' => { self.subset_closed = true; self.phase = DoctypePhase::Main; }
                    _ => {}
                },
                DoctypePhase::SubsetQuote => if byte == self.quote { self.phase = DoctypePhase::Subset; },
                DoctypePhase::Lt => match byte {
                    b'!' => { self.phase = DoctypePhase::Bang; return DoctypeResult::More; }
                    b'?' => { self.run = 0; self.phase = DoctypePhase::Pi; return DoctypeResult::More; }
                    _ => { self.phase = DoctypePhase::Subset; continue; }
                },
                DoctypePhase::Bang => if byte == b'-' { self.phase = DoctypePhase::BangDash; return DoctypeResult::More; } else { self.phase = DoctypePhase::Subset; continue; },
                DoctypePhase::BangDash => if byte == b'-' { self.run = 0; self.phase = DoctypePhase::Comment; return DoctypeResult::More; } else { self.phase = DoctypePhase::Subset; continue; },
                DoctypePhase::Comment => {
                    if byte == b'-' { self.run = self.run.saturating_add(1).min(2); }
                    else if byte == b'>' && self.run >= 2 { self.phase = DoctypePhase::Subset; }
                    else { self.run = 0; }
                }
                DoctypePhase::Pi => {
                    if byte == b'>' && self.run == 1 { self.phase = DoctypePhase::Subset; }
                    else { self.run = u8::from(byte == b'?'); }
                }
            }
            return DoctypeResult::More;
        }
    }
}

/// Borrowing scanner. Source bytes remain immutable and are never normalized.
pub struct XmlReader<'a> {
    source: &'a [u8],
    bytes_read: usize,
    token_start: usize,
    name_offset: usize,
    name_length: usize,
    attribute_count: usize,
    probe_position: usize,
    mode: Mode,
    probe: Probe,
    closing: bool,
    name_complete: bool,
    in_quote: bool,
    pending_slash: bool,
    self_closing: bool,
    quote: u8,
    complete: bool,
    element_seen: bool,
    doctype_seen: bool,
    doctype: DoctypeState,
    diagnostic: Diagnostic,
}

impl<'a> XmlReader<'a> {
    /// Starts a reader borrowing `source` until this reader is dropped.
    pub fn new(source: &'a [u8]) -> Result<Self, ReaderStatus> {
        if source.len() > MAX_READER_SOURCE_BYTES { return Err(ReaderStatus::Limit); }
        Ok(Self {
            source, bytes_read: 0, token_start: 0, name_offset: 0, name_length: 0,
            attribute_count: 0, probe_position: 0, mode: Mode::Text, probe: Probe::None,
            closing: false, name_complete: false, in_quote: false, pending_slash: false,
            self_closing: false, quote: 0, complete: false, element_seen: false,
            doctype_seen: false, doctype: DoctypeState::default(), diagnostic: Diagnostic::clear(),
        })
    }

    /// Advances by at most `byte_budget` bytes, capped at 64 KiB, and emits
    /// complete lexical tags. Returning false from the callback is an error.
    pub fn step<F>(&mut self, byte_budget: usize, mut on_tag: F) -> ReaderStatus
    where F: FnMut(ReaderTag) -> bool {
        if byte_budget == 0 { return ReaderStatus::Invalid; }
        if self.diagnostic.category != XmlError::None { return ReaderStatus::Malformed; }
        if self.complete { return ReaderStatus::Complete; }
        let budget = byte_budget.min(MAX_READER_STEP_BYTES);
        let end = self.bytes_read.saturating_add(budget).min(self.source.len());
        while self.bytes_read < end && self.diagnostic.category == XmlError::None {
            let at = self.bytes_read;
            let byte = self.source[at];
            match self.mode {
                Mode::Text => if byte == b'<' {
                    self.mode = Mode::Probe;
                    self.token_start = at;
                    self.probe = Probe::None;
                    self.probe_position = 0;
                },
                Mode::Probe => self.scan_probe(byte, at),
                Mode::Tag => {
                    if !self.name_complete {
                        if is_reader_name_byte(byte) {
                            if self.name_length == MAX_READER_NAME_BYTES { self.fail(XmlError::InvalidName, self.name_offset); }
                            else { self.name_length += 1; }
                            self.bytes_read += 1;
                            continue;
                        }
                        if self.name_length == 0 { self.fail(XmlError::InvalidName, self.name_offset); }
                        else { self.name_complete = true; }
                    }
                    if self.in_quote {
                        if byte == self.quote { self.in_quote = false; }
                    } else if byte == b'\'' || byte == b'"' {
                        self.in_quote = true;
                        self.quote = byte;
                        self.attribute_count = self.attribute_count.saturating_add(1);
                    } else if byte == b'/' { self.pending_slash = true; }
                    else if byte == b'>' {
                        self.self_closing = self.pending_slash;
                        if !self.emit_tag(at + 1, &mut on_tag) { break; }
                    } else { self.pending_slash = false; }
                }
                Mode::Comment if byte == b'>' && at >= 2 && &self.source[at - 2..at] == b"--" => self.mode = Mode::Text,
                Mode::Cdata if byte == b'>' && at >= 2 && &self.source[at - 2..at] == b"]]" => self.mode = Mode::Text,
                Mode::Doctype => match self.doctype.step(byte) {
                    DoctypeResult::Bad => self.fail(XmlError::MalformedSyntax, at),
                    DoctypeResult::Done => self.mode = Mode::Text,
                    DoctypeResult::More => {}
                },
                Mode::Pi if byte == b'>' && at > 0 && self.source[at - 1] == b'?' => self.mode = Mode::Text,
                _ => {}
            }
            self.bytes_read += 1;
        }
        if self.diagnostic.category != XmlError::None { return ReaderStatus::Malformed; }
        if self.bytes_read == self.source.len() {
            if self.mode != Mode::Text { self.fail(XmlError::IncompleteDocument, self.source.len()); }
            else { self.complete = true; }
        }
        if self.diagnostic.category == XmlError::None {
            if self.complete { ReaderStatus::Complete } else { ReaderStatus::Ok }
        } else { ReaderStatus::Malformed }
    }

    pub fn progress(&self) -> ReaderProgress {
        ReaderProgress { bytes_read: self.bytes_read, source_bytes: self.source.len(), diagnostic: self.diagnostic, complete: self.complete }
    }

    fn scan_probe(&mut self, byte: u8, at: usize) {
        if self.probe_position == 0 {
            if byte == b'?' { self.mode = Mode::Pi; }
            else if byte == b'/' {
                self.begin_tag(true, at + 1);
            } else if byte == b'!' { self.probe_position = 1; }
            else if is_reader_name_byte(byte) {
                self.begin_tag(false, at);
                self.name_length = 1;
            } else { self.fail(XmlError::InvalidName, at); }
        } else if self.probe == Probe::None {
            if byte == b'-' { self.probe = Probe::Comment; self.probe_position = 1; }
            else if byte == b'[' { self.probe = Probe::Cdata; self.probe_position = 1; }
            else if byte == b'D' && !self.doctype_seen && !self.element_seen {
                self.probe = Probe::Doctype;
                self.probe_position = 1;
            } else { self.fail(XmlError::UnsupportedDtd, self.token_start); }
        } else if self.probe == Probe::Comment {
            if byte != b'-' { self.fail(XmlError::MalformedSyntax, self.token_start); }
            else { self.mode = Mode::Comment; }
        } else if self.probe == Probe::Doctype {
            const TAIL: &[u8] = b"OCTYPE";
            let index = self.probe_position - 1;
            if TAIL.get(index).copied() != Some(byte) { self.fail(XmlError::UnsupportedDtd, self.token_start); }
            else if self.probe_position == TAIL.len() {
                self.mode = Mode::Doctype;
                self.doctype_seen = true;
                self.doctype = DoctypeState::default();
            } else { self.probe_position += 1; }
        } else {
            const TAIL: &[u8] = b"CDATA[";
            let index = self.probe_position - 1;
            if index >= TAIL.len() || TAIL[index] != byte { self.fail(XmlError::MalformedSyntax, self.token_start); }
            else if self.probe_position == TAIL.len() { self.mode = Mode::Cdata; }
            else { self.probe_position += 1; }
        }
    }

    fn begin_tag(&mut self, closing: bool, name_offset: usize) {
        self.mode = Mode::Tag;
        self.closing = closing;
        self.name_offset = name_offset;
        self.name_length = 0;
        self.attribute_count = 0;
        self.name_complete = false;
        self.pending_slash = false;
    }

    fn emit_tag<F>(&mut self, end: usize, callback: &mut F) -> bool
    where F: FnMut(ReaderTag) -> bool {
        if self.name_length == 0 || self.name_length > MAX_READER_NAME_BYTES {
            self.fail(XmlError::InvalidName, self.name_offset);
            return false;
        }
        if !self.closing { self.element_seen = true; }
        let kind = if self.closing { TagKind::EndElement } else if self.self_closing { TagKind::EmptyElement } else { TagKind::StartElement };
        let tag = ReaderTag {
            kind,
            source: Span { start: self.token_start, end },
            name: Span { start: self.name_offset, end: self.name_offset + self.name_length },
            attribute_count: self.attribute_count,
        };
        if !callback(tag) {
            self.fail(XmlError::OutputExhausted, self.token_start);
            return false;
        }
        self.mode = Mode::Text;
        true
    }

    fn fail(&mut self, category: XmlError, offset: usize) {
        if self.diagnostic.category == XmlError::None {
            self.diagnostic = Diagnostic { category, offset: offset.min(self.source.len()) };
        }
    }
}

fn is_reader_name_byte(byte: u8) -> bool {
    byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || byte >= 0x80 || matches!(byte, b'_' | b'-' | b'.' | b':')
}
