/// Every variable token-name source load, including comparison operands, uses
/// this budget gate. The legacy `reads` counter measures scanner loads only;
/// `total_reads` includes scanner and comparison loads without cursor inference.
#[derive(Default)]
struct NameWork {
    remaining: usize, spent: usize,
    #[cfg(test)] reads: usize,
    #[cfg(test)] decoder_inputs: usize,
    #[cfg(test)] comparison_reads: usize,
    #[cfg(test)] total_reads: usize,
}
impl NameWork {
    fn begin(&mut self, budget: usize) { self.remaining=budget;self.spent=0; }
    fn load(&mut self, source: &[u8], at: usize, comparison: bool) -> Option<u8> {
        if self.remaining==0{return None}
        self.remaining-=1;self.spent+=1;
        let byte=source[at];
        #[cfg(test)] {
            self.total_reads+=1;
            if comparison{self.comparison_reads+=1}else{self.reads+=1}
        }
        #[cfg(not(test))] let _=comparison;
        Some(byte)
    }
    fn read(&mut self, source: &[u8], at: usize) -> Option<u8> { self.load(source,at,false) }
    fn decode(&mut self, utf8: &mut Utf8Scan, byte: u8, at: usize) -> Result<Option<u32>, usize> {
        #[cfg(test)] { self.decoder_inputs += 1; }
        utf8.push(byte, at)
    }
}

const ENTITIES: [&[u8]; 5]=[b"lt",b"gt",b"amp",b"apos",b"quot"];
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct NameClass { xml_exact: bool, xml_folded: bool, entities: u8 }
impl NameClass {
    fn new()->Self{Self{xml_exact:true,xml_folded:true,entities:31}}
    fn push(&mut self,cp:u32,offset:usize){
        self.xml_exact&=b"xml".get(offset).is_some_and(|v|u32::from(*v)==cp);
        self.xml_folded&=cp<128&&b"xml".get(offset).is_some_and(|v|*v==(cp as u8).to_ascii_lowercase());
        for (i,name) in ENTITIES.iter().enumerate(){
            if !name.get(offset).is_some_and(|v|u32::from(*v)==cp){self.entities&=!(1<<i)}
        }
    }
    fn known_entity(self,len:usize)->bool{ENTITIES.iter().enumerate().any(|(i,n)|self.entities&(1<<i)!=0&&n.len()==len)}
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct NameCompare { left:XmlSpan, right:XmlSpan, index:usize, left_byte:Option<u8> }
#[derive(PartialEq, Eq)]
enum CompareStatus { Pending, Equal, Different, Canceled }
impl NameCompare {
    fn new(left:XmlSpan,right:XmlSpan)->Self{Self{left,right,index:0,left_byte:None}}
    fn step<C:FnMut()->bool>(&mut self,source:&[u8],work:&mut NameWork,cancel:&mut C)->CompareStatus{
        if self.left.length!=self.right.length{return CompareStatus::Different}
        while self.index<self.left.length{
            if work.remaining==0{return CompareStatus::Pending}
            if cancel(){return CompareStatus::Canceled}
            if self.left_byte.is_none(){
                self.left_byte=work.load(source,self.left.offset+self.index,true);
                continue
            }
            let Some(right)=work.load(source,self.right.offset+self.index,true)else{return CompareStatus::Pending};
            if self.left_byte.take()!=Some(right){return CompareStatus::Different}
            self.index+=1;
        }
        CompareStatus::Equal
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum DtdPhase { Start, Main, Quote, Subset, SubsetQuote, Lt, Bang, BangDash, Comment, Pi }
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct Dtd { phase: DtdPhase, quote: u8, run: u8, subset_closed: bool }
impl Default for Dtd { fn default() -> Self { Self { phase: DtdPhase::Start, quote: 0, run: 0, subset_closed: false } } }
impl Dtd {
    fn step(&mut self, c: u8) -> Result<bool, ()> {
        loop { match self.phase {
            DtdPhase::Start => { if !is_xml_whitespace(c) { return Err(()) } self.phase=DtdPhase::Main; return Ok(false) },
            DtdPhase::Main => match c { b'"'|b'\''=>{self.quote=c;self.phase=DtdPhase::Quote},b'['=>{if self.subset_closed{return Err(())}self.phase=DtdPhase::Subset},b'>'=>return Ok(true),b'<'=>return Err(()),_=>{} },
            DtdPhase::Quote=>if c==self.quote{self.phase=DtdPhase::Main},
            DtdPhase::Subset=>match c {b'"'|b'\''=>{self.quote=c;self.phase=DtdPhase::SubsetQuote},b'<'=>self.phase=DtdPhase::Lt,b']'=>{self.subset_closed=true;self.phase=DtdPhase::Main},_=>{}},
            DtdPhase::SubsetQuote=>if c==self.quote{self.phase=DtdPhase::Subset},
            DtdPhase::Lt=>match c{b'!'=>{self.phase=DtdPhase::Bang;return Ok(false)},b'?'=>{self.run=0;self.phase=DtdPhase::Pi;return Ok(false)},_=>{self.phase=DtdPhase::Subset;continue}},
            DtdPhase::Bang=>if c==b'-'{self.phase=DtdPhase::BangDash;return Ok(false)}else{self.phase=DtdPhase::Subset;continue},
            DtdPhase::BangDash=>if c==b'-'{self.run=0;self.phase=DtdPhase::Comment;return Ok(false)}else{self.phase=DtdPhase::Subset;continue},
            DtdPhase::Comment=>if c==b'-'{self.run=(self.run+1).min(2)}else if c==b'>'&&self.run>=2{self.phase=DtdPhase::Subset}else{self.run=0},
            DtdPhase::Pi=>if c==b'>'&&self.run==1{self.phase=DtdPhase::Subset}else{self.run=u8::from(c==b'?')},
        } return Ok(false) }
    }
}

pub struct XmlTokenStream<'a> {
    source:&'a [u8], limits:XmlLimits, result:XmlResult, tokens:Vec<XmlToken>,
    tag_scratch:Vec<XmlToken>, token_capacity:usize, visitor_mode:bool,
    cursor:usize, parse_limit:usize, char_cursor:usize, utf8:Utf8Scan, name_work:NameWork,
    chars_complete:bool, depth:usize, roots:usize, total_attrs:usize, open_names:Vec<XmlSpan>,
    pending:Pending, tag:Option<TagState>, doctype_seen:bool, complete:bool, canceled:bool, failed:bool, taken:bool,
}

impl<'a> XmlTokenStream<'a> {
    pub fn new(source:&'a [u8],max_storage_bytes:usize)->Result<Self,StreamStatus>{
        if max_storage_bytes<size_of::<XmlToken>(){return Err(StreamStatus::Failed)}
        Self::construct(source,max_storage_bytes,false)
    }
    pub fn new_visitor(source:&'a [u8])->Result<Self,StreamStatus>{
        let scratch=MAX_ATTRIBUTES_PER_ELEMENT.checked_add(1).and_then(|n|n.checked_mul(size_of::<XmlToken>())).ok_or(StreamStatus::Failed)?;
        Self::construct(source,scratch,true)
    }
    fn construct(source:&'a [u8],max_storage_bytes:usize,visitor_mode:bool)->Result<Self,StreamStatus>{
        if source.len()>MAX_LARGE_INPUT_BYTES{return Err(StreamStatus::Failed)}
        let limits=XmlLimits{input_bytes:MAX_LARGE_INPUT_BYTES,..XmlLimits::default()};
        let mut tag_scratch=Vec::new();
        if visitor_mode {
            let scratch_capacity=MAX_ATTRIBUTES_PER_ELEMENT.checked_add(1).ok_or(StreamStatus::Failed)?;
            if tag_scratch.try_reserve_exact(scratch_capacity).is_err()
                || tag_scratch.capacity()>scratch_capacity || tag_scratch.capacity()<scratch_capacity {
                return Err(StreamStatus::Failed)
            }
        }
        let mut open_names=Vec::new();
        if open_names.try_reserve_exact(MAX_DEPTH).is_err()
            || open_names.capacity()>MAX_DEPTH || open_names.capacity()<MAX_DEPTH {
            return Err(StreamStatus::Failed)
        }
        let cursor=if source.starts_with(b"\xef\xbb\xbf"){3}else{0};
        Ok(Self{source,limits,result:XmlResult::default(),tokens:Vec::new(),tag_scratch,token_capacity:max_storage_bytes/size_of::<XmlToken>(),visitor_mode,
            cursor,parse_limit:cursor,char_cursor:0,utf8:Utf8Scan::default(),name_work:NameWork::default(),chars_complete:false,depth:0,roots:0,total_attrs:0,open_names,
            pending:Pending::None,tag:None,doctype_seen:false,complete:false,canceled:false,failed:false,taken:false})
    }

    pub(crate) fn with_limits(source:&'a [u8],limits:XmlLimits,token_capacity:usize)->Result<Self,StreamStatus>{
        let mut stream=Self::construct(source,0,false)?;
        stream.limits=limits;
        stream.token_capacity=token_capacity.min((isize::MAX as usize)/size_of::<XmlToken>());
        Ok(stream)
    }

    pub fn step(&mut self,budget:usize,canceled:bool)->StreamStatus{
        let mut poll=||canceled;
        self.step_inner(budget,&mut poll,None)
    }
    pub fn step_with_visitor<F:FnMut(&XmlToken)->bool>(&mut self,budget:usize,canceled:bool,visitor:&mut F)->StreamStatus{
        let mut poll=||canceled;
        self.step_inner(budget,&mut poll,Some(visitor))
    }
    pub fn step_with_visitor_and_cancel<F:FnMut(&XmlToken)->bool,C:FnMut()->bool>(&mut self,budget:usize,visitor:&mut F,cancel:&mut C)->StreamStatus{
        self.step_inner(budget,cancel,Some(visitor))
    }
    pub fn step_with_cancel<C:FnMut()->bool>(&mut self,budget:usize,cancel:&mut C)->StreamStatus{
        self.step_inner(budget,cancel,None)
    }
    fn step_inner<C:FnMut()->bool>(&mut self,budget:usize,cancel:&mut C,mut visitor:Option<&mut dyn FnMut(&XmlToken)->bool>)->StreamStatus{
        let status=self.advance_step(budget,cancel,&mut visitor);
        if matches!(status,StreamStatus::Failed|StreamStatus::Canceled){
            self.failed|=status==StreamStatus::Failed;
            self.tokens.clear();self.tag_scratch.clear();
            self.result.token_count=0;self.result.element_count=0;
            self.result.attribute_count=0;self.result.node_count=0;
        }
        status
    }
    fn advance_step<C:FnMut()->bool>(&mut self,budget:usize,cancel:&mut C,visitor:&mut Option<&mut dyn FnMut(&XmlToken)->bool>)->StreamStatus{

        }

            if self.depth!=0||self.roots==0{self.fail(XmlError::IncompleteDocument,self.source.len());return self.failed_or_canceled()}
            self.complete=true;
        }
        if self.complete{StreamStatus::Complete}else{StreamStatus::Ok}
    }
    fn scan_chars<C:FnMut()->bool>(&mut self,budget:usize,cancel:&mut C)->bool{
        let end=self.char_cursor.saturating_add(budget).min(self.source.len());
        while self.char_cursor<end{
            if cancel(){self.canceled=true;return false}
            let at=self.char_cursor;
            match self.utf8.push(self.source[at],at){
                Err(start)=>{self.fail(XmlError::InvalidUtf8,start);return false},
                Ok(Some(cp)) if !is_xml_char(cp)=>{self.fail(XmlError::InvalidCharacter,self.utf8.start);return false},
                Ok(_)=>self.char_cursor+=1,
            }
        }
        if self.char_cursor==self.source.len(){
            if self.utf8.incomplete(){self.fail(XmlError::InvalidUtf8,self.utf8.start);return false}
            self.chars_complete=true
        }
        true
    }
    fn parse_next<C:FnMut()->bool>(&mut self,limit:usize,visitor:&mut Option<&mut dyn FnMut(&XmlToken)->bool>,cancel:&mut C)->bool{
        if self.tag.is_some(){return self.parse_tag(limit,visitor,cancel)}
        if !matches!(self.pending,Pending::None){return self.parse_pending(limit,visitor,cancel)}
        let p=self.cursor;if p>=limit{return true}

        }

        if self.source.get(p..p.saturating_add(2))==Some(b"<?"){self.pending=Pending::Pi{start:p,pos:p+2,name_scan:None,name:None,declaration:false,data:None,separating:false,question:false};return self.parse_pending(limit,visitor,cancel)}

static _Atomic uint64_t next_document_id = 1U;

static bool allocate_document_id(uint64_t *out_id)
{
    uint64_t current = atomic_load_explicit(&next_document_id, memory_order_relaxed);
    for (;;) {
        if (current == 0U || current == UINT64_MAX) return false;
        if (atomic_compare_exchange_weak_explicit(&next_document_id, &current,
                current + 1U, memory_order_relaxed, memory_order_relaxed)) {
            *out_id = current;
            return true;
        }
    }
}

static void append_child(document_model *model, uint32_t parent, uint32_t child)
{
    document_node *parent_node = &model->nodes[parent];
    if (parent_node->first_child == UINT32_MAX) parent_node->first_child = child;
    else model->nodes[parent_node->last_child].next_sibling = child;
    parent_node->last_child = child;
}

/// A source-owning model. Cloning this value is intentionally unsupported so
/// each document identity has exactly one owner and one live-state table.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct OwnedDocumentModel {
    pub(crate) source: Arc<Vec<u8>>,
    pub(crate) core: DocumentCore,
}

macro_rules! document_queries {
    ($($impl:tt)+ ; $bytes:ty) => {
        $($impl)+ {
            pub fn document_id(&self) -> u64 { self.core.document_id() }
            pub fn source(&self) -> $bytes { &self.source }
            pub fn node_count(&self) -> usize { self.core.node_count() }
            pub fn live_node_count(&self) -> usize { self.core.live_node_count() }
            pub fn root(&self) -> Option<DocumentHandle> { self.core.root() }
            pub fn first_child(&self, parent: DocumentHandle) -> Option<DocumentHandle> { self.core.first_child(parent) }
            pub fn next_sibling(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<DocumentHandle> { self.core.next_sibling(handle) }
            pub fn parent(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<DocumentHandle> { self.core.parent(handle) }
            pub fn tag_name(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<$bytes> {
                self.core.resolve(handle)?.name.slice(&self.source)
            }
            pub fn attribute_count(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> usize { self.core.attribute_count(handle) }
            pub fn attribute_at(&self, handle: DocumentHandle, index: usize) -> Option<($bytes, $bytes)> {
                let (name, value) = self.core.attribute_spans(handle, index)?;
                Some((name.slice(&self.source)?, value.slice(&self.source)?))
            }
            pub fn depth(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<usize> { self.core.depth(handle) }
            pub fn node_at(&self, slot: usize) -> Option<DocumentHandle> { self.core.node_at(slot) }
            pub fn source_span(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<DocumentSourceSpan> { self.core.source_span(handle) }
            pub fn remove_subtree(&mut self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> bool { self.core.remove_subtree(handle) }
        }
    };
}

document_queries!(impl<'source> DocumentModel<'source>; &'source [u8]);
document_queries!(impl OwnedDocumentModel; &[u8]);

pub(crate) fn checked_table_bytes<T>(count: usize) -> Option<usize> {
    count.checked_mul(size_of::<T>())
}

pub(crate) const fn no_slot() -> u32 { NO_SLOT }

/// Index data shared by borrowed and Arc-owned source models.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub(crate) struct DocumentCore {
    pub(crate) id: u64,
    pub(crate) nodes: Vec<Node>,
    pub(crate) attributes: Vec<Attribute>,
    pub(crate) live_node_count: usize,
    pub(crate) root: Option<u32>,
}

impl DocumentCore {
    pub(crate) fn from_parts(
        id: u64,
        nodes: Vec<Node>,
        attributes: Vec<Attribute>,
        root: Option<u32>,
    ) -> Self {
        let live_node_count = nodes.len();
        Self { id, nodes, attributes, live_node_count, root }
    }

    pub fn document_id(&self) -> u64 { self.id }
    pub fn node_count(&self) -> usize { self.nodes.len() }
    pub fn live_node_count(&self) -> usize { self.live_node_count }

    pub fn root(&self) -> Option<DocumentHandle> {
        let slot = self.root?;
        self.nodes.get(slot as usize).filter(|node| node.live)?;
        Some(self.handle(slot))
    }

    pub fn first_child(&self, parent: DocumentHandle) -> Option<DocumentHandle> {
        let node = self.resolve(parent)?;
        let mut child = node.first_child;
        while child != NO_SLOT {
            let current = self.nodes.get(child as usize)?;
            if current.live { return Some(self.handle(child)); }
            child = current.next_sibling;
        }
        None
    }

    pub fn next_sibling(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<DocumentHandle> {
        let node = self.resolve(handle)?;
        let mut sibling = node.next_sibling;
        while sibling != NO_SLOT {
            let current = self.nodes.get(sibling as usize)?;
            if current.live { return Some(self.handle(sibling)); }
            sibling = current.next_sibling;
        }
        None
    }

    pub fn parent(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<DocumentHandle> {
        let node = self.resolve(handle)?;
        if node.parent == NO_SLOT { return None; }
        self.nodes.get(node.parent as usize).filter(|parent| parent.live)?;
        Some(self.handle(node.parent))
    }

    pub fn attribute_count(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> usize {
        self.resolve(handle).map_or(0, |node| node.attribute_count)
    }

    fn attribute_spans(&self, handle: DocumentHandle, index: usize) -> Option<(vexel_xml::XmlSpan, vexel_xml::XmlSpan)> {
        let node = self.resolve(handle)?;
        if index >= node.attribute_count { return None; }
        let attribute = self.attributes.get(node.first_attribute.checked_add(index)?)?;
        Some((attribute.name, attribute.value))
    }

    pub fn depth(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<usize> {
        Some(self.resolve(handle)?.depth)
    }

    pub fn node_at(&self, slot: usize) -> Option<DocumentHandle> {
        let index = u32::try_from(slot).ok()?;
        self.nodes.get(slot).filter(|node| node.live)?;
        Some(self.handle(index))
    }

    pub fn source_span(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<DocumentSourceSpan> {
        Some(self.resolve(handle)?.source)
    }

    /// Removes a node and all descendants. Slots remain stable; each live
    /// generation advances so previously issued handles cannot resolve.
    pub fn remove_subtree(&mut self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> bool {
        if self.resolve(handle).is_none() { return false; }
        for index in 0..self.nodes.len() {
            if !self.is_descendant_or_self(index, handle.slot as usize) { continue; }
            let node = &mut self.nodes[index];
            if node.live {
                node.live = false;
                self.live_node_count -= 1;
                if node.generation != u32::MAX { node.generation += 1; }
            }
        }
        if self.root == Some(handle.slot) { self.root = None; }
        true
    }

    fn is_descendant_or_self(&self, index: usize, ancestor: usize) -> bool {
        let mut current = index;
        loop {
            if current == ancestor { return true; }
            let Some(node) = self.nodes.get(current) else { return false; };
            if node.parent == NO_SLOT { return false; }
            current = node.parent as usize;
        }
    }

    fn resolve(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<&Node> {
        if handle.document_id != self.id { return None; }
        let node = self.nodes.get(handle.slot as usize)?;
        (node.live && node.generation == handle.generation).then_some(node)
    }

    fn handle(&self, slot: u32) -> DocumentHandle {
        DocumentHandle { document_id: self.id, slot, generation: self.nodes[slot as usize].generation }
    }
}

macro_rules! document_query_methods {
    ($bytes:ty) => {
            pub fn document_id(&self) -> u64 { self.core.document_id() }
            pub fn source(&self) -> $bytes { &self.source }
            pub fn node_count(&self) -> usize { self.core.node_count() }
            pub fn live_node_count(&self) -> usize { self.core.live_node_count() }
            pub fn root(&self) -> Option<DocumentHandle> { self.core.root() }
            pub fn first_child(&self, parent: DocumentHandle) -> Option<DocumentHandle> { self.core.first_child(parent) }
            pub fn next_sibling(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<DocumentHandle> { self.core.next_sibling(handle) }
            pub fn parent(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<DocumentHandle> { self.core.parent(handle) }
            pub fn tag_name(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<$bytes> {
                self.core.resolve(handle)?.name.slice(&self.source)
            }
            pub fn attribute_count(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> usize { self.core.attribute_count(handle) }
            pub fn attribute_at(&self, handle: DocumentHandle, index: usize) -> Option<($bytes, $bytes)> {
                let (name, value) = self.core.attribute_spans(handle, index)?;
                Some((name.slice(&self.source)?, value.slice(&self.source)?))
            }
            pub fn depth(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<usize> { self.core.depth(handle) }
            pub fn node_at(&self, slot: usize) -> Option<DocumentHandle> { self.core.node_at(slot) }
            pub fn source_span(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<DocumentSourceSpan> { self.core.source_span(handle) }
            pub fn remove_subtree(&mut self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> bool { self.core.remove_subtree(handle) }
    };
}

fn parse_core<C: FnMut() -> bool>(source: &[u8], source_limit: usize, storage_limit: usize, cancel: &mut C) -> Result<DocumentCore, BuildFailure> {
    let parse_error = |error, diagnostic| BuildFailure::Parse(DocumentParseError { error, diagnostic });
    if storage_limit < size_of::<XmlToken>() {
        return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::ResourceExhausted, XmlDiagnostic::default()));
    }
    if source.len() > source_limit {
        return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::Limit, XmlDiagnostic { category: XmlError::InputLimit, offset: 0 }));
    }

    let mut stream = XmlTokenStream::new(source, storage_limit).map_err(|_| parse_error(DocumentError::OutOfMemory, XmlDiagnostic::default()))?;
    if stream.token_storage_bytes() > storage_limit
        || stream.open_name_storage_bytes() > MAX_OPEN_NAME_BYTES
    {
        return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::OutOfMemory, XmlDiagnostic::default()));
    }
    let status = loop {
        let status = stream.step_with_cancel(STEP_BYTES, cancel);
        if stream.token_storage_bytes() > storage_limit
            || stream.open_name_storage_bytes() > MAX_OPEN_NAME_BYTES
        {
            return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::OutOfMemory, stream.result().diagnostic));
        }
        if status != StreamStatus::Ok { break status; }
    };
    let result = stream.result();
    if status == StreamStatus::Canceled { return Err(BuildFailure::Canceled { offset: 0 }); }
    if status != StreamStatus::Complete || result.diagnostic.category != XmlError::None {
        let error = match result.diagnostic.category {
            XmlError::InputLimit | XmlError::NodeLimit | XmlError::DepthLimit | XmlError::AttributeLimit
            | XmlError::TextLimit => DocumentError::Limit,
            XmlError::OutputExhausted => DocumentError::ResourceExhausted,
            XmlError::None => DocumentError::OutOfMemory,
            _ => DocumentError::Parse,
        };
        return Err(parse_error(error, result.diagnostic));
    }

    if result.element_count == 0 || result.element_count > MAX_NODES || result.element_count > u32::MAX as usize
        || result.attribute_count > vexel_xml::MAX_TOTAL_ATTRIBUTES
        || checked_table_bytes::<Node>(result.element_count).is_none()
        || checked_table_bytes::<Attribute>(result.attribute_count).is_none()
    {
        return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::Limit, result.diagnostic));
    }
    let tokens = stream.take().ok_or_else(|| parse_error(DocumentError::Parse, result.diagnostic))?;
    if stream.token_storage_bytes() != 0 {
        return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::Parse, result.diagnostic));
    }

    let id = allocate_document_id().ok_or_else(|| parse_error(DocumentError::IdExhausted, result.diagnostic))?;
    let (nodes, attributes, root) = build_tables(source, &tokens, result.element_count, result.attribute_count, cancel)
        .map_err(|failure| match failure { TableFailure::Parse(error) => parse_error(error, result.diagnostic), TableFailure::Canceled { offset } => BuildFailure::Canceled { offset } })?;
    Ok(DocumentCore::from_parts(id, nodes, attributes, Some(root)))
}

enum TableFailure { Parse(DocumentError), Canceled { offset: usize } }
impl From<DocumentError> for TableFailure { fn from(error: DocumentError) -> Self { Self::Parse(error) } }

fn build_tables(
    source: &[u8],
    tokens: &[XmlToken],
    node_count: usize,
    attribute_count: usize,
    cancel: &mut impl FnMut() -> bool,
) -> Result<(Vec<Node>, Vec<Attribute>, u32), TableFailure> {
    let parse_error = |error| TableFailure::Parse(error);
    let mut nodes: Vec<Node> = Vec::new();
    nodes.try_reserve_exact(node_count).map_err(|_| parse_error(DocumentError::OutOfMemory))?;
    if nodes.capacity() > MAX_NODES { return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::OutOfMemory)); }
    let mut attributes: Vec<Attribute> = Vec::new();
    attributes.try_reserve_exact(attribute_count).map_err(|_| parse_error(DocumentError::OutOfMemory))?;
    if attributes.capacity() > vexel_xml::MAX_TOTAL_ATTRIBUTES { return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::OutOfMemory)); }
    let mut stack: Vec<u32> = Vec::new();
    stack.try_reserve_exact(MAX_DEPTH).map_err(|_| parse_error(DocumentError::OutOfMemory))?;
    if stack.capacity() > MAX_DEPTH { return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::OutOfMemory)); }

    let mut root = None;
    let mut index = 0usize;
    while index < tokens.len() {
        if cancel() { return Err(TableFailure::Canceled { offset: tokens.get(index).map_or(source.len(), |token| token.source.offset) }); }
        let token = tokens[index];
        match token.kind {
            TokenKind::StartElement | TokenKind::EmptyElement => {
                if nodes.len() >= node_count || nodes.len() >= MAX_NODES || nodes.len() >= u32::MAX as usize
                    || token.name.slice(source).is_none() || checked_span(token.source, source).is_none()
                {
                    return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::Parse));
                }
                let slot = u32::try_from(nodes.len()).map_err(|_| parse_error(DocumentError::Limit))?;
                let parent = stack.last().copied().unwrap_or(no_slot());
                let depth = stack.len();
                let mut node = Node {
                    name: token.name,
                    source: DocumentSourceSpan { offset: token.source.offset, length: token.source.length },
                    first_attribute: attributes.len(),
                    depth,
                    parent,
                    ..Node::default()
                };
                if parent != no_slot() {
                    let parent_index = parent as usize;
                    let parent_node = nodes.get(parent_index).ok_or_else(|| parse_error(DocumentError::Parse))?;
                    let previous_last = parent_node.last_child;
                    if parent_node.first_child == no_slot() { nodes[parent_index].first_child = slot; }
                    else {
                        let previous = nodes.get_mut(previous_last as usize).ok_or_else(|| parse_error(DocumentError::Parse))?;
                        previous.next_sibling = slot;
                    }
                    nodes[parent_index].last_child = slot;
                } else if parent == no_slot() {
                    if root.replace(slot).is_some() { return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::Parse)); }
                } else {
                    return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::Parse));
                }

                index += 1;
                while let Some(attribute) = tokens.get(index).filter(|next| next.kind == TokenKind::Attribute) {
                    if cancel() { return Err(TableFailure::Canceled { offset: attribute.source.offset }); }
                    if attributes.len() >= attribute_count || attribute.name.slice(source).is_none()
                        || attribute.value.slice(source).is_none() || checked_span(attribute.source, source).is_none()
                    {
                        return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::Parse));
                    }
                    attributes.push(Attribute { name: attribute.name, value: attribute.value });
                    node.attribute_count += 1;
                    index += 1;
                }
                nodes.push(node);
                if token.kind == TokenKind::StartElement {
                    if stack.len() >= MAX_DEPTH { return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::Limit)); }
                    stack.push(slot);
                }
            }
            TokenKind::EndElement => {
                let Some(slot) = stack.pop() else { return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::Parse)); };
                let node = nodes.get_mut(slot as usize).ok_or_else(|| parse_error(DocumentError::Parse))?;
                let end = token.source.offset.checked_add(token.source.length).ok_or_else(|| parse_error(DocumentError::Parse))?;
                let node_end = node.source.offset.checked_add(node.source.length).ok_or_else(|| parse_error(DocumentError::Parse))?;
                if node.source.offset > token.source.offset || end < node_end || end > source.len()
                    || token.name.slice(source).is_none()
                {
                    return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::Parse));
                }
                node.source.length = end.checked_sub(node.source.offset).ok_or(DocumentError::Parse)?;
                index += 1;
            }
            _ => index += 1,
        }
    }
    if !stack.is_empty() || nodes.len() != node_count || attributes.len() != attribute_count {
        return Err(parse_error(DocumentError::Parse));
    }
    Ok((nodes, attributes, root.ok_or(DocumentError::Parse)?))
}

fn checked_span<'a>(span: XmlSpan, source: &'a [u8]) -> Option<&'a [u8]> {
    let end = span.offset.checked_add(span.length)?;
    source.get(span.offset..end)
}

**ACCEPT** — no blockers found in the scoped implementation. Borrowed parsing keeps its signature, lifetime, 16 MiB cap, and offset-0 input-limit diagnostic. The owned APIs borrow the caller’s `Arc`, clone it only after successful parsing, and share the same cached tables and query logic. I found no unsafe code, duplicated model identity, source copy, query-time rebuild, or partial-model return on failure. Cancellation is polled during XML processing and table construction, with offsets documented in [parse.rs](/Users/megasoft78/Desktop/Freelance/vexel/.worktrees/rust6-owned-document/rust/crates/vexel-document/src/parse.rs:14).

The nine original test bodies remain in [tests.rs](/Users/megasoft78/Desktop/Freelance/vexel/.worktrees/rust6-owned-document/rust/crates/vexel-document/src/tests.rs:14); additional coverage exercises owned queries, handles, deletion, `Arc` lifetime/sharing, cancellation, and sources over 16 MiB including 100 MiB. Source files are under 800 lines. The candidate’s [verification record](/Users/megasoft78/Desktop/Freelance/vexel/.worktrees/rust6-owned-document/artifacts/WO-RUST-DOCUMENT-OWNED-01/verification.txt) reports the named checks passing; I did not run tests or builds, as requested. This review makes no full-app or performance claim.

**Non-blocking gaps**

- The new large/owned entrypoints lack direct tests for malformed input, token-storage exhaustion, and the 1 GiB boundary. Existing borrowed tests and shared parsing code cover much of that behavior, but entrypoint-specific cases would strengthen the evidence.
- The 100 MiB case validates a large attribute value and source sharing; it does not establish large-document throughput.
